apiBusinessModelCanvas.title: API Business Model Canvas
apiBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Wie praktikabel und wiederverwendbar wird diese API sein? Haben wir einen Business Case aus Kosten-Nutzen-Sicht?
apiBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Fassen Sie das Wertversprechen einer API aus dem API Value Proposition Canvas zusammen und folgen Sie dann der nummerierten Reihenfolge.

keyPartners.description: Wer sind die wichtigsten beteiligten Stakeholder?

keyActivities.description: Welche wichtigsten Aktivitäten muss der API-Anbieter ausführen, damit die API erfolgreich betrieben werden kann?

keyResources.description: Welche strategischen Ressourcen muss der API-Anbieter beschaffen oder aufbauen?

apiValueProposition.description: Beginnen Sie mit einem Haftzettel, auf dem Sie die API oder die API-Familie benennen, und erfassen Sie dann, welchen Nutzen die API den API-Nutzern bietet.

developerRelations.description: Wie erreicht und unterstützt der API-Anbieter die API-Nutzer?

channels.description: Über welche Mechanismen interagieren API-Nutzer mit der API?

apiConsumerSegments.description: Wer sind die Zielgruppen für die API?

costs.description: Welche wesentlichen Kosten entstehen durch Aufbau, Bereitstellung und Betrieb der API?

benefits.description: Was sind die wesentlichen Vorteile oder Einnahmequellen, die durch die API generiert werden?

apiValuePropositionCanvas.title: API Value Proposition Canvas
apiValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Wie hängt die Customer Journey mit APIs zusammen? Welche Pain Points und Nutzen von Endnutzern und API-Nutzern müssen adressiert werden?
apiValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Beschreiben Sie die Perspektive der Endnutzer: zuerst ihre Aufgaben, dann ihre Pain Points und Nutzen sowie die der API-Nutzer, und schließlich die API-Produkte und API-Funktionen.

tasks.description: Was möchten Kunden oder Endnutzer erreichen?

gainEnablingFeatures.description: Welche Funktionen helfen Endnutzern und API-Nutzern, den gewünschten Nutzen zu erreichen?

painRelievingFeatures.section: Funktionen zur Reduktion von Pain Points
painRelievingFeatures.description: Welche Funktionen helfen Endnutzern und API-Nutzern, Pain Points zu reduzieren?

apiProducts.description: Welche API-Produkte und -Features eigenen sich für diese Aufgaben, Probleme und Bedürfnisse?

businessImpactCanvas.title: Business Impact Canvas
businessImpactCanvas.purpose: What value, risk, operational, financial, customer, employee, compliance, and strategic impact is expected or at stake?
businessImpactCanvas.howToUse: Use this to connect expected benefits and consequences to architecture, prioritization, readiness, and proceed-or-stop decisions. Include the impact of not proceeding as well as critical risks and mitigations.

availabilityRisks.description: Was sind die potenziellen Risiken für die API-Verfügbarkeit?

securityRisks.description: Welche potenziellen Sicherheitsrisiken sind mit der API assoziiert?

dataRisks.description: Welche potenziellen Risiken bestehen für die Datenintegrität oder -Vertraulichkeit?

expectedBenefits.description: What business, customer, employee, quality, speed, risk, compliance, or strategic benefits are expected?

operationalEfficiencyImpact.description: How could work effort, waiting time, rework, throughput, reliability, support load, or operational cost change?

customerEmployeeImpact.description: How will customers, employees, partners, operators, or support teams experience the change?

financialImpact.description: What revenue, cost, investment, savings, loss avoidance, or funding impact is expected?

complianceStrategicImpact.description: What regulatory, contractual, policy, reputation, market, ecosystem, or strategic consequences matter?

impactOfNotProceeding.description: What happens if the capability, automation, integration, or service is not improved or delivered?

risksAndCriticality.description: What availability, security, data, safety, process, adoption, or business continuity risks could affect the outcome?

mitigationsAndDecisionImpact.description: Which mitigations, constraints, trade-offs, or residual risks should influence prioritization, architecture, rollout, or readiness decisions?

capacityCanvas.title: Capacity Canvas
capacityCanvas.purpose: How much demand, load, timing, and scaling capacity must be understood for the capability, automation, integration, or service?
capacityCanvas.howToUse: Quantify current and expected demand, peak load, and availability needs. Record caching, rate limiting, and scaling approaches as architecture follow-up decisions rather than user requirements.

currentBusinessVolumes.description: Wie hoch sind das aktuelle Geschäftsvolumen und die Transaktionsraten?

futureConsumptionTrends.description: Was sind die erwarteten künftigen Konsumtrends?

peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.description: Was sind die Spitzenlast- und Verfügbarkeitsanforderungen?

cachingStrategies.description: Welche Caching-Strategien können zur Performanceoptimierung eingesetzt werden?

rateLimitingStrategies.description: Welche Strategien zur Ratenbegrenzung können genutzt werden, um die Nutzung zu steuern?

scalingStrategies.description: Welche Strategien zur Skalierung können eingesetzt werden, um das Wachstum zu unterstützen?

customerJourneyCanvas.title: Customer Journey Canvas
customerJourneyCanvas.purpose: Welche Customer Journey oder Partner Journey erzeugt den Bedarf für eine Capability oder Schnittstelle?
customerJourneyCanvas.howToUse: Beschreiben Sie eine reale Reise eines Kunden, Partners oder Nutzers - nicht die API-Nutzung selbst. Diese Reise macht Probleme, Ziele und Kontext sichtbar und hilft, spätere Anforderungen an Capability- und Schnittstellendesign zu klären.

customerDiscoversNeed.description: Wie erkennt der Kunde oder Nutzer ein Bedürfnis oder Problem?

persona.description: Wer ist der typische Kunde oder Nutzer, der diese Reise erlebt?

pains.description: Welche Probleme oder Pain Points erlebt der Kunde oder Nutzer?

journeySteps.description: Welche Schritte durchläuft der Kunde bei der Reise?

customerNeedIsResolved.description: Wie wird der Bedarf des Kunden oder Nutzers letztlich erfüllt?

gains.description: Welchen Gewinn oder Nutzen hat der Kunde?

inputsOutputs.description: Was sind die Inputs und Outputs bei jedem Schritt?

interactionProcessingRules.description: Wie lauten die Interaktions- und Verarbeitungsregeln bei jedem Schritt?

domainCanvas.title: Domain Canvas
domainCanvas.purpose: Welche wesentlichen Entitäten, Begriffe und Fachregeln muss die Capability oder Schnittstelle respektieren?
domainCanvas.howToUse: Definieren Sie das Fachdomänenmodell für die Capability oder Schnittstelle, einschließlich Entitäten, Attributen und Beziehungen.

selectedCustomerJourneySteps.description: Welche Customer Journey Schritte sind für diese Domäne relevant?

coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.description: Welches sind die wesentlichen Entitäten und ihre Bedeutung für das Geschäft?

attributesAndBusinessImportance.description: Welches sind die Schlüsselattribute der einzelnen Entitäten und ihre geschäftliche Wichtigkeit?

relationshipsBetweenEntities.description: Welche Beziehungen bestehen zwischen den Entitäten?

businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.description: Welche Fachregeln sowie Compliance- und Integritätsanforderungen beziehen sich auf die Entitäten?

securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.description: Welche Überlegungen zur Sicherheit und zum Datenschutz gibt es im Zusammenhang mit den Entitäten?

eventCanvas.title: Event Canvas
eventCanvas.purpose: Welche Ereignisse sind für die Capability oder Schnittstelle relevant und wie werden sie verarbeitet?
eventCanvas.howToUse: Definieren Sie Ereignisse, Auslöser und Verarbeitungslogik für die Capability oder Schnittstelle.

userTaskTrigger.description: Welche Nutzeraktion oder welches Systemereignis löst diese Ereignisoperation aus?

inputEventPayload.description: Welche Daten sind in der eingehenden Event-Payload enthalten? Geben Sie die Schlüsselattribute an.

processingLogic.description: Beschreiben Sie die Verarbeitungslogik der Backend-Systeme, einschließlich Validierungen, Transformationen oder Routing-Entscheidungen.

outputEventResult.description: Welches Event oder welche Bestätigungsmeldung wird erzeugt? Geben Sie die Attribute des Output-Payloads an.

interactionCanvas.title: Interaction Canvas
interactionCanvas.purpose: Welche Arten von Interaktionen muss diese Capability oder Schnittstelle unterstützen, bevor ein konkretes Protokolldesign gewählt wird?
interactionCanvas.howToUse: Identifizieren Sie, welche Interaktionsstile wirklich benötigt werden und welche außerhalb des Umfangs liegen. Nutzen Sie dieses Canvas, um die Absicht zu klären, bevor das Ergebnis auf REST, Events oder GraphQL abgebildet wird.

crudInteractions.description: Sind hier Interaktionen im CRUD-Stil erforderlich?

crudInputOutputModels.description: Was sind die Eingabe- und Ausgabemodelle für die CRUD-Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil benötigt wird?

crudProcessingValidation.description: Was sind die Verarbeitungs- und Validierungsregeln für die CRUD-Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil benötigt wird?

queryDrivenInteractions.description: Welche Lese- oder Abfrageinteraktionen sind erforderlich, um Nutzerfragen zu beantworten?

queryDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Was sind die Eingabe- und Ausgabemodelle für die abfragegesteuerten Interaktionen?

queryDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Was sind die Verarbeitungs- und Validierungsregeln für die abfragegesteuerten Interaktionen?

commandDrivenInteractions.description: Welche Befehle zur Zustandsänderung sind gegebenenfalls erforderlich?

commandDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Was sind die Eingabe- und Ausgabemodelle für die befehlsgesteuerten Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil benötigt wird?

commandDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Was sind die Verarbeitungs- und Validierungsregeln für die befehlsgesteuerten Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil benötigt wird?

eventDrivenInteractions.description: Welche Ereignisse müssen gegebenenfalls veröffentlicht oder verarbeitet werden?

eventDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Was sind die Eingabe- und Ausgabemodelle für die ereignisgesteuerten Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil erforderlich ist?

eventDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Was sind die Verarbeitungs- und Validierungsregeln für die ereignisgesteuerten Interaktionen, falls dieser Stil benötigt wird?

locationsCanvas.title: Locations Canvas
locationsCanvas.purpose: Welche geopolitischen, regulatorischen, Netzwerk- und Vertrauensgrenzen betreffen diese Capability oder Schnittstelle?
locationsCanvas.howToUse: Identifizieren Sie, wo Nutzer, Anbieter und abhängige Systeme in internen Netzwerken, Partnernetzwerken, im öffentlichen Internet und in regulierten Regionen betrieben werden. Beschreiben Sie die Auswirkungen auf Latenz, Vertrauen, Compliance und Konnektivität.

locationGroups.description: Welche geopolitischen, regulatorischen, netzwerkbezogenen oder vertrauensbezogenen Gruppen sind relevant?

locationGroupCharacteristics.description: Was sind die Merkmale dieser Gruppen, wie z. B. Standort, Vertrauensstufe oder Netzwerkexposition?

locations.description: Was sind die relevanten Standorte, Zonen oder Umgebungen innerhalb jeder Gruppe?

locationCharacteristics.description: Was sind die Merkmale dieser Standorte oder Zonen, wie z. B. Eigentumsverhältnisse, Region oder Exposition?

locationDistances.description: Welche Latenz-, Vertrauens-, Regulierungs- oder Konnektivitätsentfernungen bestehen zwischen den Standorten?

locationDistanceCharacteristics.description: Was sind die Merkmale dieser Entfernungen, wie z. B. Latenzempfindlichkeit, Aufenthaltsbeschränkungen oder Vertrauensgrenzen?

locationEndpoints.description: Welche Konnektivitätsendpunkte oder Schnittstellen sind mit den Standorten verbunden?

locationEndpointCharacteristics.description: Welche Eigenschaften weisen diese Endpunkte auf, wie z. B. Sichtbarkeit, Protokoll, Sicherheit oder Zugriffsbeschränkungen?

restCanvas.title: REST Canvas
restCanvas.purpose: Wie kann die API nach RESTful-Prinzipien gestaltet werden?
restCanvas.howToUse: Definieren Sie Ressourcen, Verben sowie Beispiele für API-Requests und API-Responses.

apiResources.description: Was sind die Schlüsselressourcen, die von der API bereitgestellt werden?

apiResourceModel.description: Wie sieht die Struktur des API-Ressourcenmodells aus?

apiVerbs.description: Welche HTTP-Methoden werden für die Interaktion mit den API-Ressourcen verwendet?

apiVerbExample.description: Geben Sie für jede HTTP-Methode ein Beispiel für eine API-Anfrage und -Antwort an.

graphqlCanvas.title: GraphQL Canvas
graphqlCanvas.purpose: Wie kann die API nach GraphQL-Prinzipien gestaltet werden?
graphqlCanvas.howToUse: Definieren Sie zentrale Typen, Queries, Mutations und Einschränkungen für die GraphQL-API.

apiName.description: Wie lautet der Name der GraphQL-API oder des Endpunkts?

consumerGoals.description: Welche Probleme versuchen API-Nutzer zu lösen? Welche Daten benötigen sie?

keyTypes.description: Welche zentralen Typen werden bereitgestellt (z. B. Nutzer, Bestellung, Produkt)?

relationships.description: Wie stehen die Typen in verschachtelten Abfragen zueinander?

queries.description: Welche typischen Abfragen sollten unterstützt werden?

mutations.description: Welche Operationen verändern Daten (z.B. erstellen, aktualisieren, löschen)?

subscriptions.description: Gibt es Echtzeit-Updates oder Ereignisse, die Nutzer abonnieren können?

authorizationRules.description: Wer darf auf welche Felder oder Typen zugreifen?

consumerConstraints.description: Gibt es Paginierungs-, Filter- oder Ratenbegrenzungen?

openQuestions.description: Gibt es noch offene Entscheidungen oder Integrationsüberlegungen?

capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.title: Capability Value Proposition Canvas
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Welche wiederverwendbare Capability würde Nutzern Wert liefern, ohne bereits zu entscheiden, ob sie als API, Event, Datei, Stream, Datenprodukt oder ein anderer Implementierungsstil bereitgestellt werden soll?
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Starten Sie mit Nutzeraufgaben und Ergebnissen. Erfassen Sie nutzenstiftende und Pain-Point-reduzierende Capability-Funktionen und beschreiben Sie mögliche wiederverwendbare Capabilities, ohne die Technologie zu früh festzulegen.

consumerTasks.description: Was möchten Nutzer, Partner, Systeme oder Teams erreichen?

gainEnablingCapabilities.description: Welche Capability-Funktionen helfen Nutzern, bessere Ergebnisse, Geschwindigkeit, Automatisierung, Erkenntnisse, Reichweite oder Compliance zu erreichen?

painRelievingCapabilities.description: Welche Capability-Funktionen reduzieren Reibung, manuelle Arbeit, Fehler, Verzögerungen, Risiken oder Unsicherheit für Nutzer?

reusableCapabilities.description: Welche wiederverwendbaren Geschäfts- oder Daten-Capabilities könnten diese Aufgaben, Nutzen und Pain Points über mehr als einen Nutzer oder Use Case hinweg unterstützen?

capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.title: Capability Business Model Canvas
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Wie tragfähig, wiederverwendbar, finanziert, verantwortet, unterstützt und auffindbar soll diese Integrations-Capability sein?
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Fassen Sie das Wertversprechen der Capability zusammen, identifizieren Sie Nutzer und Interaktionskanäle und erfassen Sie anschließend Verantwortlichkeiten, Aktivitäten, Ressourcen, Partner, Nutzen und Kosten.

keyPartners.description: Welche Partner aus Business, Technologie, Daten, Sicherheit, Recht, Plattform oder externen Organisationen werden benötigt, damit die Capability funktioniert?

keyActivities.description: Was müssen Capability Owner und Produzenten tun, um die Capability zu gestalten, bereitzustellen, zu steuern, zu unterstützen und zu verbessern?

keyResources.description: Welche Systeme, Datenbestände, Plattformen, Personen, Standards, Finanzierungen und operativen Fähigkeiten werden benötigt?

capabilityValueProposition.description: Welchen Wert liefert diese wiederverwendbare Capability für Nutzer und für die Organisation oder das Ökosystem?

consumerEngagement.description: Wie werden Nutzer die Capability entdecken, bewerten, anfordern, onboarden, Unterstützung erhalten und Feedback geben?

channels.description: Über welche Kataloge, Portale, Marktplätze, Dokumentationsseiten, Support-Wege oder Governance-Prozesse interagieren Nutzer mit der Capability?

capabilityConsumerSegments.description: Wer sind die aktuellen und potenziellen Nutzer der Capability, einschließlich Teams, Partnern, Systemen, Produkten oder Datennutzern?

costs.description: Welche wesentlichen Kosten entstehen durch Aufbau, Betrieb, Governance, Support und Weiterentwicklung der Capability?

benefits.description: Welcher geschäftliche, operative, ökologische, wiederverwendungsbezogene, Compliance- oder Kostennutzen rechtfertigt die Capability?

consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.title: Experience Requirements Canvas
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.purpose: What experience, operational, and non-functional requirements must the solution satisfy for users, operators, consumers, approvers, and support teams?
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.howToUse: Capture what people and consuming systems require from the capability or automation. Keep this focused on requirements and constraints; quantify capacity and choose implementation mechanisms in later architecture work.

consumerGoals.description: What business, workflow, decision, automation, support, or data usage goals must be supported?

availabilityAndTimeliness.description: When must the solution be available, how fresh must information be, and what response, delivery, or completion windows matter to users and operators?

volumeAndPerformance.description: What user, case, transaction, record, event, file, batch, or work-item volumes must be understood before capacity planning?

dataQualityAndConsistency.description: What accuracy, completeness, consistency, ordering, deduplication, reconciliation, or validation expectations do users, operators, or consuming systems have?

securityPrivacyAndCompliance.description: What identity, authorization, confidentiality, residency, consent, retention, audit, or regulatory constraints must the solution satisfy?

onboardingAndAccess.description: How do users, operators, or consuming teams gain access, initiate or participate in the solution, and receive the required permissions and guidance?

changeAndVersioning.description: How much change tolerance exists, and what notice, compatibility, migration, training, or versioning expectations apply?

observabilityAndSupport.description: What monitoring, status, traceability, quality visibility, support, ownership, and incident communication do users and operators need?

recoveryAndContinuity.description: What replay, retry, reconciliation, backup, fallback, continuity, or manual recovery expectations must be supported?

architectureImplications.description: Which requirements must later architecture, workflow, capacity, integration, or implementation decisions satisfy?

automationOpportunityCanvas.title: Automation Hypothesis Canvas
automationOpportunityCanvas.purpose: Link evidence from optional supporting canvases to a testable automation hypothesis before committing to architecture or delivery.
automationOpportunityCanvas.howToUse: Start with the Automation Hypothesis Canvas. Reference Journey, Value Proposition, Domain, Business Impact, Capacity, or other evidence only where it is relevant; do not repeat those canvases here.

hypothesis.description: What do we believe automating which work for which actor will achieve? Use the form: We believe automating [work] for [actor] will achieve [outcome].

supportingEvidence.description: Which Journey, Value Proposition, Business Impact, Capacity, Domain, or other evidence supports this hypothesis? Link or reference existing artifacts instead of repeating them.

automationScope.description: Which part of the work is being considered for automation now, and what is explicitly outside scope?

responsibilityAndSolutionHypothesis.description: What is the current assumption about how the automation might be implemented? This is an assumption to validate, not an architecture decision.

criticalAssumptions.description: Which assumptions could invalidate value, feasibility, safety, operability, compliance, or adoption?

validationExperiment.description: What is the smallest useful PoC or investigation, what evidence and thresholds decide success, and what stop conditions apply?

decision.description: What is the evidence-based decision: supported, revise and retest, redesign the process first, or reject?

humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.title: Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.purpose: Decide what should be performed by people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, or UI automation.
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.howToUse: List target process steps and decide the most appropriate performer for each step. Capture required oversight, escalation, and evidence so the solution does not assume every step should be automated.

processStep.description: Which step in the target process is being assigned or reviewed?

humanResponsibility.description: What should a person do, decide, approve, review, correct, or own?

ruleOrWorkflowResponsibility.description: What can be handled by deterministic rules, orchestration, routing, reminders, or scheduled workflow?

agentOrAiResponsibility.description: What judgement, language, classification, generation, planning, or assistance may an agent or AI perform?

apiOrSystemResponsibility.description: What should be performed through system capability, API, event, connector, file, or direct integration?

rpaOrUiAutomationResponsibility.description: Where is UI automation justified because no suitable system, API, event, connector, or data access path exists?

requiredOversight.description: What human supervision, approval, confirmation, monitoring, or review is required before or after the step?

escalation.description: When should the step stop, ask for help, route to a person, or move to another support path?

evidenceOrAuditTrail.description: What record proves what happened, who or what acted, what data was used, and what decision was made?

automationWorkflowCanvas.title: Automation Workflow Canvas
automationWorkflowCanvas.purpose: Design the sequence, states, data, triggers, decisions, interactions, failure paths, and recovery for the end-to-end automation workflow.
automationWorkflowCanvas.howToUse: Use the responsibility allocation from the Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas as an input. Focus here on how the workflow runs, changes state, exchanges data, handles exceptions, produces evidence, and recovers.

trigger.description: What event, schedule, user action, message, data change, or manual request starts the automation?

inputs.description: What data, documents, messages, forms, records, or context are required at the start and during the workflow?

workflowStages.description: What are the main workflow stages and states from trigger to completion, including waiting, review, exception, and completion states?

decisionsAndRules.description: Which deterministic rules, validations, thresholds, policies, or decision points shape the flow?

agentActions.description: What may the automation, workflow, rule, agent, integration, API, RPA, or system component do at each relevant stage?

systemInteractions.description: Which systems, APIs, events, connectors, custom components, files, or screens are called or updated?

dataSources.description: Which source systems, datasets, records, documents, or knowledge sources are used and trusted?

humanTasks.description: Where does the responsibility allocation require approval, confirmation, judgement, correction, review, or manual completion?

handoffs.description: Where does work move between automation components, people, support teams, systems, queues, or exception paths?

exceptions.description: What error, missing-data, conflicting-data, timeout, permission, unsafe-action, or business exception scenarios must be handled?

retriesAndTimeouts.description: Where are retries, timeout limits, duplicate prevention, idempotency, pause rules, or compensation required?

outputs.description: What records, decisions, messages, documents, updates, notifications, or outcomes are produced?

auditEvidence.description: What log, trace, approval, run history, input snapshot, output record, or explanation proves correct operation?

monitoringPoints.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, quality, safety, or outcome metrics should be observed?

recoveryPath.description: How can the process be paused, rolled back, compensated, rerun, corrected, or completed manually?

automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.title: Automation Architecture Decision Canvas
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.purpose: Compare and justify alternative implementation mechanisms for an automation solution.
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.howToUse: Mark each candidate mechanism as considered, selected, rejected, or not relevant. Compare only the viable candidates individually and as a hybrid, then justify the recommended implementation approach using feasibility, reliability, security, maintainability, latency, scalability, cost, dependency, testability, observability, recoverability, skills, and architectural fit.

nativeFeature.description: Can an existing system capability solve this step with acceptable reliability, controls, and ownership?

workflow.description: Where is workflow orchestration, scheduling, routing, approval, notification, or coordination the best fit?

rule.description: Which decisions can be implemented as deterministic business rules, policy checks, validations, or calculations?

agent.description: Where could an agent or AI safely add judgement, language understanding, generation, planning, or assistance?

connector.description: Which low-code, platform, SaaS, file, message, or data connectors are viable?

api.description: Where is an API call the best fit for reliable, governed, testable system interaction?

event.description: Where should the solution react to, publish, or consume events?

customCode.description: Where is custom code justified because standard capabilities are insufficient or too risky?

rpa.description: Where is desktop or UI automation justified, and what fragility or recovery controls are required?

humanTask.description: Which steps should remain human because of judgement, accountability, risk, consent, policy, or exception handling?

feasibilityReliabilitySecurity.description: How do candidates compare on technical feasibility, expected reliability, identity, authorization, data exposure, and control strength?

maintainabilityScalabilityCost.description: How do candidates compare on change effort, operating cost, licence cost, transaction volume, peak load, and lifecycle maintenance?

latencyObservabilityRecoverability.description: How do candidates compare on timing needs, monitoring, logs, traceability, retry, compensation, and manual recovery?

skillsVendorFit.description: What skills, ownership, platform dependencies, governance constraints, and architecture standards affect the decision?

recommendedHybridApproach.description: Which combination of people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, events, custom code, and UI automation should be used?

decisionRationale.description: Why is this approach preferred over the alternatives, and what evidence supports the decision?

openQuestionsAndRisks.description: Which assumptions, risks, dependencies, or unresolved constraints must be validated before delivery or release?

automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.title: Automation Readiness & Operations Canvas
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.purpose: Prepare the operating model for a safely released, supported, monitored, and recoverable automation.
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.howToUse: Use this during delivery to prepare ownership, environments, access, evidence, monitoring, support, fallback, rollback, runbooks, known risks, and the deployment decision. Use the readiness checklist later for the release gate.

businessOwner.description: Who accepts business value, process impact, residual risk, and release timing?

operationalOwner.description: Who owns runtime supervision, incidents, support, runbooks, changes, and recovery?

users.description: Which users, operators, approvers, support teams, or process participants are affected?

permissions.description: What human, service, system, data, role, and approval permissions are required and approved?

credentials.description: How are credentials, secrets, certificates, tokens, delegated access, and service identities managed?

environments.description: Which development, test, staging, production, desktop, cloud, or platform environments are used?

testEvidence.description: What proves functional correctness, rule behavior, integration behavior, agent behavior, permissions, performance, and exceptions?

exceptionHandling.description: How are errors, missing data, unsafe actions, failed runs, retries, timeouts, and handoffs handled?

monitoring.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, value, safety, and outcome signals are monitored?

support.description: Who supports users and operators, how are incidents raised, and what service expectations apply?

manualFallback.description: How can work continue manually if the automation is paused, unavailable, incorrect, or unsafe?

rollback.description: How can changes, actions, data updates, releases, or workflow versions be reversed or compensated?

documentation.description: What operating instructions, design records, architecture decisions, user guidance, and runbooks are ready?

deploymentDecision.description: What remains incomplete, conditional, or blocking before the formal readiness decision?

knownRisks.description: Which risks are accepted, mitigated, deferred, or blocking release?

improvementBacklog.description: Which improvements, unresolved assumptions, PoC findings, and future enhancements should be prioritized next?

apiBusinessModelCanvas.title: API Business Model Canvas
apiBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: How feasible and reusable will this API be? Do we have a business case from a cost - benefit point of view?
apiBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Summarize the value proposition of one API from the API Value Proposition Canvas, then follow the numbered sequence.

keyPartners.description: Who are the key stakeholders involved?

keyActivities.description: What are the most important actions the API provider must take to operate successfully?

keyResources.description: What unique strategic assets must the API provider acquire or build?

apiValueProposition.description: Start with one sticky note naming the API or API family, then capture what value the API offers to API consumers.

developerRelations.description: How does the API provider reach and support API consumers?

channels.description: Through which mechanisms do API consumers interact with the API?

apiConsumerSegments.description: Who are the target audiences for the API?

costs.description: What are the significant costs involved in building, deploying, and operating the API?

benefits.description: What are the significant benefits or revenue streams generated by the API?

apiValuePropositionCanvas.title: API Value Proposition Canvas
apiValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: How does the customer journey map to APIs? What end-user and API consumer pains, and gains need to be addressed?
apiValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Describe the end-users' perspective, starting with their tasks, then their and API consumers' pains and gains, and finally the API's products and features.

tasks.description: What are the customers (end-users) trying to achieve?

gainEnablingFeatures.description: What features enable end-users and API consumers to achieve gains?

painRelievingFeatures.description: What features help end-users and  API consumers overcome pains?

apiProducts.description: What API products and features address the tasks, pains, and gains?

businessImpactCanvas.title: Business Impact Canvas
businessImpactCanvas.purpose: What value, risk, operational, financial, customer, employee, compliance, and strategic impact is expected or at stake?
businessImpactCanvas.howToUse: Use this to connect expected benefits and consequences to architecture, prioritization, readiness, and proceed-or-stop decisions. Include the impact of not proceeding as well as critical risks and mitigations.

availabilityRisks.description: What are the potential risks to capability availability?

securityRisks.description: What are the potential security risks associated with the capability?

dataRisks.description: What are the potential risks to data integrity or confidentiality?

mitigateAvailabilityRisks.description: How can the capability owner mitigate the availability risks?

mitigateSecurityRisks.description: How can the capability owner mitigate the security risks?

mitigateDataRisks.description: How can the capability owner mitigate the data risks?

expectedBenefits.description: What business, customer, employee, quality, speed, risk, compliance, or strategic benefits are expected?

operationalEfficiencyImpact.description: How could work effort, waiting time, rework, throughput, reliability, support load, or operational cost change?

customerEmployeeImpact.description: How will customers, employees, partners, operators, or support teams experience the change?

financialImpact.description: What revenue, cost, investment, savings, loss avoidance, or funding impact is expected?

complianceStrategicImpact.description: What regulatory, contractual, policy, reputation, market, ecosystem, or strategic consequences matter?

impactOfNotProceeding.description: What happens if the capability, automation, integration, or service is not improved or delivered?

risksAndCriticality.description: What availability, security, data, safety, process, adoption, or business continuity risks could affect the outcome?

mitigationsAndDecisionImpact.description: Which mitigations, constraints, trade-offs, or residual risks should influence prioritization, architecture, rollout, or readiness decisions?

capacityCanvas.title: Capacity Canvas
capacityCanvas.purpose: How much demand, load, timing, and scaling capacity must be understood for the capability, automation, integration, or service?
capacityCanvas.howToUse: Quantify current and expected demand, peak load, and availability needs. Record caching, rate limiting, and scaling approaches as architecture follow-up decisions rather than user requirements.

currentBusinessVolumes.description: What are the current business volumes and transaction rates?

futureConsumptionTrends.description: What are the anticipated future consumption trends?

peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.description: What are the peak load and availability requirements?

cachingStrategies.description: What caching strategies can be used to optimize performance?

rateLimitingStrategies.description: What rate limiting strategies can be used to manage consumption?

scalingStrategies.description: What scaling strategies can be used to accommodate growth?

customerJourneyCanvas.title: Customer Journey Canvas
customerJourneyCanvas.purpose: What customer, partner, or consumer journey is the capability intended to support?
customerJourneyCanvas.howToUse: Describe the real-life customer, partner, or consumer journey, not the solution usage itself, to reveal pain points, goals, context, inputs, outputs, and experience expectations.

customerDiscoversNeed.description: How does the customer recognize their need or problem?

persona.description: Who is the typical customer experiencing this journey?

pains.description: What are the customer's pain points or challenges?

journeySteps.description: What are the steps the customer takes in their journey?

customerNeedIsResolved.description: How is the customer's need ultimately resolved?

gains.description: What are the customer's gains or benefits?

inputsOutputs.description: What are the inputs and outputs at each step?

interactionProcessingRules.description: What are the interaction and processing rules at each step?

domainCanvas.title: Domain Canvas
domainCanvas.purpose: What are the core entities and business rules related to this capability or domain?
domainCanvas.howToUse: Define the domain model, including entities, attributes, relationships, ownership, and business rules.

selectedCustomerJourneySteps.description: Which customer journey steps are relevant to this domain?

coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.description: What are the core entities and their business meaning?

attributesAndBusinessImportance.description: What are the key attributes of each entity and their business importance?

relationshipsBetweenEntities.description: What are the relationships between the entities?

businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.description: What are the business, compliance, and integrity rules related to the entities?

securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.description: What are the security and privacy considerations related to the entities?

eventCanvas.title: Event Canvas
eventCanvas.purpose: What events are relevant to the API, and how are they processed?
eventCanvas.howToUse: Define the events, their triggers, and the processing logic for each API.

userTaskTrigger.description: What user action or system event triggers this event operation?

inputEventPayload.description: What data is included in the incoming event payload? Specify key attributes.

processingLogic.description: Describe the backend processing logic, including validations, transformations, or routing decisions.

outputEventResult.description: What resulting event or acknowledgment is produced? Include attributes of the output payload.

interactionCanvas.title: Interaction Canvas
interactionCanvas.purpose: What kinds of interactions should this capability support before choosing a protocol-specific design?
interactionCanvas.howToUse: Identify which interaction styles are actually needed for this capability, and which are out of scope. Use this canvas to clarify intent before mapping the result to REST, events, GraphQL, or another selected implementation style.

crudInteractions.description: Are CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) interactions needed here?

crudInputOutputModels.description: What are the input and output models for the CRUD interactions, if this style is needed?

crudProcessingValidation.description: What are the processing and validation rules for the CRUD interactions, if this style is needed?

queryDrivenInteractions.description: What read or query interactions are needed to answer consumer questions?

queryDrivenInputOutputModels.description: What are the input and output models for the query-driven interactions?

queryDrivenProcessingValidation.description: What are the processing and validation rules for the query-driven interactions?

commandDrivenInteractions.description: What state-changing commands are needed, if any?

commandDrivenInputOutputModels.description: What are the input and output models for the command-driven interactions, if this style is needed?

commandDrivenProcessingValidation.description: What are the processing and validation rules for the command-driven interactions, if this style is needed?

eventDrivenInteractions.description: What events need to be published or consumed, if any?

eventDrivenInputOutputModels.description: What are the input and output models for the event-driven interactions, if this style is needed?

eventDrivenProcessingValidation.description: What are the processing and validation rules for the event-driven interactions, if this style is needed?

locationsCanvas.title: Locations Canvas
locationsCanvas.purpose: What geopolitical, regulatory, network, and trust boundaries affect this capability or integration?
locationsCanvas.howToUse: Identify where consumers, producers, and dependent systems operate across internal networks, partner networks, public internet, and regulated regions. Describe the latency, trust, compliance, and connectivity implications between them.

locationGroups.description: What are the relevant geopolitical, regulatory, network, or trust groups?

locationGroupCharacteristics.description: What are the characteristics of those groups, such as residency, trust level, or network exposure?

locations.description: What are the relevant locations, zones, or environments within each group?

locationCharacteristics.description: What are the characteristics of those locations or zones, such as ownership, region, or exposure?

locationDistances.description: What latency, trust, regulatory, or connectivity distances exist between the locations?

locationDistanceCharacteristics.description: What are the characteristics of those distances, such as latency sensitivity, residency constraints, or trust boundaries?

locationEndpoints.description: What connectivity endpoints or interfaces are associated with the locations?

locationEndpointCharacteristics.description: What are the characteristics of those endpoints, such as exposure, protocol, security, or access restrictions?

restCanvas.title: REST Canvas
restCanvas.purpose: How can the API be designed using RESTful principles?
restCanvas.howToUse: Define the API resources, verbs, and example requests and responses.

apiResources.description: What are the key resources exposed by the API?

apiResourceModel.description: What is the structure of the API resource model?

apiVerbs.description: What HTTP verbs are used to interact with the API resources?

apiVerbExample.description: Provide an example of an API request and response for each verb.

graphqlCanvas.title: GraphQL Canvas
graphqlCanvas.purpose: How can the API be designed using GraphQL principles?
graphqlCanvas.howToUse: Define the key types, queries, mutations, and constraints for your GraphQL API.

apiName.description: What is the name of the GraphQL API or endpoint?

consumerGoals.description: What problems are API consumers trying to solve? What data do they need?

keyTypes.description: What are the core types exposed (e.g., User, Order, Product)?

relationships.description: How do types relate to each other in nested queries?

queries.description: What common queries should be supported?

mutations.description: What operations will modify data (e.g., create, update, delete)?

subscriptions.description: Are there any real-time updates or events consumers can subscribe to?

authorizationRules.description: Who can access which fields or types?

consumerConstraints.description: Are there pagination, filtering, or rate-limiting constraints?

openQuestions.description: Any pending decisions or integration considerations?

capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.title: Capability Value Proposition Canvas
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Which reusable capability would create value for consumers without deciding yet whether it should be delivered as an API, event, file, stream, data product, or another implementation style?
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Start from consumer tasks and outcomes. Capture gain-enabling and pain-relieving capability features, then describe candidate reusable capabilities without naming the technology too early.

consumerTasks.description: What are consumers, partners, users, systems, or teams trying to achieve?

gainEnablingCapabilities.description: What capability features would help consumers achieve better outcomes, speed, automation, insight, reach, or compliance?

painRelievingCapabilities.description: What capability features would remove friction, manual work, errors, delays, risk, or uncertainty for consumers?

reusableCapabilities.description: What reusable business or data capabilities could serve these tasks, gains, and pains across more than one consumer or use case?

capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.title: Capability Business Model Canvas
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: How viable, reusable, funded, owned, supported, and discoverable should this integration capability be?
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Summarize the capability value proposition, identify consumers and engagement channels, then map ownership, activities, resources, partners, benefits, and costs.

keyPartners.description: Which business, technology, data, security, legal, platform, or external partners are needed to make the capability work?

keyActivities.description: What must the capability owner and producers do to design, deliver, govern, support, and improve the capability?

keyResources.description: Which systems, data assets, platforms, people, standards, funding, and operational capabilities are required?

capabilityValueProposition.description: What value does this reusable capability provide to consumers and to the organization or ecosystem?

consumerEngagement.description: How will consumers discover, evaluate, request, onboard, get support for, and provide feedback on the capability?

channels.description: Through which catalogs, portals, marketplaces, documentation sites, support paths, or governance processes will consumers interact with the capability?

capabilityConsumerSegments.description: Who are the current and potential consumers of the capability, including teams, partners, systems, products, or data users?

costs.description: What are the significant costs of building, operating, governing, supporting, and evolving the capability?

benefits.description: What business, operational, ecosystem, reuse, compliance, or cost benefits justify the capability?

consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.title: Experience Requirements Canvas
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.purpose: What experience, operational, and non-functional requirements must the solution satisfy for users, operators, consumers, approvers, and support teams?
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.howToUse: Capture what people and consuming systems require from the capability or automation. Keep this focused on requirements and constraints; quantify capacity and choose implementation mechanisms in later architecture work.

consumerGoals.description: What business, workflow, decision, automation, support, or data usage goals must be supported?

availabilityAndTimeliness.description: When must the solution be available, how fresh must information be, and what response, delivery, or completion windows matter to users and operators?

volumeAndPerformance.description: What user, case, transaction, record, event, file, batch, or work-item volumes must be understood before capacity planning?

dataQualityAndConsistency.description: What accuracy, completeness, consistency, ordering, deduplication, reconciliation, or validation expectations do users, operators, or consuming systems have?

securityPrivacyAndCompliance.description: What identity, authorization, confidentiality, residency, consent, retention, audit, or regulatory constraints must the solution satisfy?

onboardingAndAccess.description: How do users, operators, or consuming teams gain access, initiate or participate in the solution, and receive the required permissions and guidance?

changeAndVersioning.description: How much change tolerance exists, and what notice, compatibility, migration, training, or versioning expectations apply?

observabilityAndSupport.description: What monitoring, status, traceability, quality visibility, support, ownership, and incident communication do users and operators need?

recoveryAndContinuity.description: What replay, retry, reconciliation, backup, fallback, continuity, or manual recovery expectations must be supported?

architectureImplications.description: Which requirements must later architecture, workflow, capacity, integration, or implementation decisions satisfy?

automationOpportunityCanvas.title: Automation Hypothesis Canvas
automationOpportunityCanvas.purpose: Link evidence from optional supporting canvases to a testable automation hypothesis before committing to architecture or delivery.
automationOpportunityCanvas.howToUse: Start with the Automation Hypothesis Canvas. Reference Journey, Value Proposition, Domain, Business Impact, Capacity, or other evidence only where it is relevant; do not repeat those canvases here.

hypothesis.description: What do we believe automating which work for which actor will achieve? Use the form: We believe automating [work] for [actor] will achieve [outcome].

supportingEvidence.description: Which Journey, Value Proposition, Business Impact, Capacity, Domain, or other evidence supports this hypothesis? Link or reference existing artifacts instead of repeating them.

automationScope.description: Which part of the work is being considered for automation now, and what is explicitly outside scope?

responsibilityAndSolutionHypothesis.description: What is the current assumption about how the automation might be implemented? This is an assumption to validate, not an architecture decision.

criticalAssumptions.description: Which assumptions could invalidate value, feasibility, safety, operability, compliance, or adoption?

validationExperiment.description: What is the smallest useful PoC or investigation, what evidence and thresholds decide success, and what stop conditions apply?

decision.description: What is the evidence-based decision: supported, revise and retest, redesign the process first, or reject?

humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.title: Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.purpose: Decide what should be performed by people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, or UI automation.
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.howToUse: List target process steps and decide the most appropriate performer for each step. Capture required oversight, escalation, and evidence so the solution does not assume every step should be automated.

processStep.description: Which step in the target process is being assigned or reviewed?

humanResponsibility.description: What should a person do, decide, approve, review, correct, or own?

ruleOrWorkflowResponsibility.description: What can be handled by deterministic rules, orchestration, routing, reminders, or scheduled workflow?

agentOrAiResponsibility.description: What judgement, language, classification, generation, planning, or assistance may an agent or AI perform?

apiOrSystemResponsibility.description: What should be performed through system capability, API, event, connector, file, or direct integration?

rpaOrUiAutomationResponsibility.description: Where is UI automation justified because no suitable system, API, event, connector, or data access path exists?

requiredOversight.description: What human supervision, approval, confirmation, monitoring, or review is required before or after the step?

escalation.description: When should the step stop, ask for help, route to a person, or move to another support path?

evidenceOrAuditTrail.description: What record proves what happened, who or what acted, what data was used, and what decision was made?

automationWorkflowCanvas.title: Automation Workflow Canvas
automationWorkflowCanvas.purpose: Design the sequence, states, data, triggers, decisions, interactions, failure paths, and recovery for the end-to-end automation workflow.
automationWorkflowCanvas.howToUse: Use the responsibility allocation from the Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas as an input. Focus here on how the workflow runs, changes state, exchanges data, handles exceptions, produces evidence, and recovers.

trigger.description: What event, schedule, user action, message, data change, or manual request starts the automation?

inputs.description: What data, documents, messages, forms, records, or context are required at the start and during the workflow?

workflowStages.description: What are the main workflow stages and states from trigger to completion, including waiting, review, exception, and completion states?

decisionsAndRules.description: Which deterministic rules, validations, thresholds, policies, or decision points shape the flow?

agentActions.description: What may the automation, workflow, rule, agent, integration, API, RPA, or system component do at each relevant stage?

systemInteractions.description: Which systems, APIs, events, connectors, custom components, files, or screens are called or updated?

dataSources.description: Which source systems, datasets, records, documents, or knowledge sources are used and trusted?

humanTasks.description: Where does the responsibility allocation require approval, confirmation, judgement, correction, review, or manual completion?

handoffs.description: Where does work move between automation components, people, support teams, systems, queues, or exception paths?

exceptions.description: What error, missing-data, conflicting-data, timeout, permission, unsafe-action, or business exception scenarios must be handled?

retriesAndTimeouts.description: Where are retries, timeout limits, duplicate prevention, idempotency, pause rules, or compensation required?

outputs.description: What records, decisions, messages, documents, updates, notifications, or outcomes are produced?

auditEvidence.description: What log, trace, approval, run history, input snapshot, output record, or explanation proves correct operation?

monitoringPoints.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, quality, safety, or outcome metrics should be observed?

recoveryPath.description: How can the process be paused, rolled back, compensated, rerun, corrected, or completed manually?

automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.title: Automation Architecture Decision Canvas
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.purpose: Compare and justify alternative implementation mechanisms for an automation solution.
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.howToUse: Mark each candidate mechanism as considered, selected, rejected, or not relevant. Compare only the viable candidates individually and as a hybrid, then justify the recommended implementation approach using feasibility, reliability, security, maintainability, latency, scalability, cost, dependency, testability, observability, recoverability, skills, and architectural fit.

nativeFeature.description: Can an existing system capability solve this step with acceptable reliability, controls, and ownership?

workflow.description: Where is workflow orchestration, scheduling, routing, approval, notification, or coordination the best fit?

rule.description: Which decisions can be implemented as deterministic business rules, policy checks, validations, or calculations?

agent.description: Where could an agent or AI safely add judgement, language understanding, generation, planning, or assistance?

connector.description: Which low-code, platform, SaaS, file, message, or data connectors are viable?

api.description: Where is an API call the best fit for reliable, governed, testable system interaction?

event.description: Where should the solution react to, publish, or consume events?

customCode.description: Where is custom code justified because standard capabilities are insufficient or too risky?

rpa.description: Where is desktop or UI automation justified, and what fragility or recovery controls are required?

humanTask.description: Which steps should remain human because of judgement, accountability, risk, consent, policy, or exception handling?

feasibilityReliabilitySecurity.description: How do candidates compare on technical feasibility, expected reliability, identity, authorization, data exposure, and control strength?

maintainabilityScalabilityCost.description: How do candidates compare on change effort, operating cost, licence cost, transaction volume, peak load, and lifecycle maintenance?

latencyObservabilityRecoverability.description: How do candidates compare on timing needs, monitoring, logs, traceability, retry, compensation, and manual recovery?

skillsVendorFit.description: What skills, ownership, platform dependencies, governance constraints, and architecture standards affect the decision?

recommendedHybridApproach.description: Which combination of people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, events, custom code, and UI automation should be used?

decisionRationale.description: Why is this approach preferred over the alternatives, and what evidence supports the decision?

openQuestionsAndRisks.description: Which assumptions, risks, dependencies, or unresolved constraints must be validated before delivery or release?

automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.title: Automation Readiness & Operations Canvas
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.purpose: Prepare the operating model for a safely released, supported, monitored, and recoverable automation.
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.howToUse: Use this during delivery to prepare ownership, environments, access, evidence, monitoring, support, fallback, rollback, runbooks, known risks, and the deployment decision. Use the readiness checklist later for the release gate.

businessOwner.description: Who accepts business value, process impact, residual risk, and release timing?

operationalOwner.description: Who owns runtime supervision, incidents, support, runbooks, changes, and recovery?

users.description: Which users, operators, approvers, support teams, or process participants are affected?

permissions.description: What human, service, system, data, role, and approval permissions are required and approved?

credentials.description: How are credentials, secrets, certificates, tokens, delegated access, and service identities managed?

environments.description: Which development, test, staging, production, desktop, cloud, or platform environments are used?

testEvidence.description: What proves functional correctness, rule behavior, integration behavior, agent behavior, permissions, performance, and exceptions?

exceptionHandling.description: How are errors, missing data, unsafe actions, failed runs, retries, timeouts, and handoffs handled?

monitoring.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, value, safety, and outcome signals are monitored?

support.description: Who supports users and operators, how are incidents raised, and what service expectations apply?

manualFallback.description: How can work continue manually if the automation is paused, unavailable, incorrect, or unsafe?

rollback.description: How can changes, actions, data updates, releases, or workflow versions be reversed or compensated?

documentation.description: What operating instructions, design records, architecture decisions, user guidance, and runbooks are ready?

deploymentDecision.description: What remains incomplete, conditional, or blocking before the formal readiness decision?

knownRisks.description: Which risks are accepted, mitigated, deferred, or blocking release?

improvementBacklog.description: Which improvements, unresolved assumptions, PoC findings, and future enhancements should be prioritized next?

apiBusinessModelCanvas.title: API-liiketoimintamallikanvas
apiBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Kuinka elinkelpoinen ja uudelleenkäytettävä tämä API on? Onko sille kustannus-hyötynäkökulmasta perusteltu liiketoimintamalli?
apiBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Tiivistä API-rajapinnan arvolupaus API-arvolupauskanvas -kanvaksesta ja etene numeroidussa järjestyksessä.

keyActivities.description: Mitkä ovat tärkeimmät toimet, jotka API-tarjoajan on toteutettava menestyäkseen?

keyResources.description: Mitä ainutlaatuisia strategisia resursseja API-tarjoajan on hankittava tai kehitettävä?

apiValueProposition.description: Aloita yhdellä tarralapulla, jossa nimeät APIn tai API-perheen, kerro sitten mitä arvoa API tarjoaa API-hyödyntäjille.

developerRelations.description: Miten API-tarjoaja tavoittaa ja tukee APIn käyttäjiä?

channels.description: Minkä kanavien kautta APIn käyttäjät ovat vuorovaikutuksessa APIn kanssa?

costs.description: Mitkä ovat merkittävimmät kustannukset APIn rakentamisessa, julkaisemisessa ja ylläpidossa?

benefits.description: Mitkä ovat APIn tuottamat merkittävät hyödyt tai tulovirrat?

apiValuePropositionCanvas.title: API-arvolupauskanvas
apiValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Miten asiakaspolku liittyy API-rajapintoihin? Mitkä loppukäyttäjien ja API-hyödyntäjien kipupisteet ja tavoitellut hyödyt täytyy huomioida?
apiValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Kuvaa loppukäyttäjien näkökulma aloittamalla heidän tehtävistään, kipupisteistään ja hyödyistään. Lisää sen jälkeen API-hyödyntäjien vastaavat tarpeet sekä API-tuotteet ja API-ominaisuudet.

tasks.description: Mitä asiakkaat tai loppukäyttäjät yrittävät saavuttaa?

gainEnablingFeatures.description: Mitkä ominaisuudet auttavat loppukäyttäjiä ja API-hyödyntäjiä saavuttamaan tavoitellut hyödyt?

painRelievingFeatures.description: Mitkä ominaisuudet auttavat loppukäyttäjiä ja API-hyödyntäjiä vähentämään kipupisteitä?

apiProducts.description: Mitkä API-tuotteet ja -ominaisuudet vastaavat tehtäviin, kipupisteisiin ja hyötyihin?

businessImpactCanvas.title: Business Impact Canvas
businessImpactCanvas.purpose: What value, risk, operational, financial, customer, employee, compliance, and strategic impact is expected or at stake?
businessImpactCanvas.howToUse: Use this to connect expected benefits and consequences to architecture, prioritization, readiness, and proceed-or-stop decisions. Include the impact of not proceeding as well as critical risks and mitigations.

availabilityRisks.description: Mitkä ovat APIn saatavuuteen liittyvät mahdolliset riskit?

securityRisks.description: Mitkä ovat API-rajapintaan liittyvät mahdolliset tietoturvariskit?

dataRisks.description: Mitkä ovat mahdolliset riskit tiedon eheydelle tai luottamuksellisuudelle?

mitigateAvailabilityRisks.description: Miten API-tarjoaja voi vähentää saatavuuteen liittyviä riskejä?

expectedBenefits.description: What business, customer, employee, quality, speed, risk, compliance, or strategic benefits are expected?

operationalEfficiencyImpact.description: How could work effort, waiting time, rework, throughput, reliability, support load, or operational cost change?

customerEmployeeImpact.description: How will customers, employees, partners, operators, or support teams experience the change?

financialImpact.description: What revenue, cost, investment, savings, loss avoidance, or funding impact is expected?

complianceStrategicImpact.description: What regulatory, contractual, policy, reputation, market, ecosystem, or strategic consequences matter?

impactOfNotProceeding.description: What happens if the capability, automation, integration, or service is not improved or delivered?

risksAndCriticality.description: What availability, security, data, safety, process, adoption, or business continuity risks could affect the outcome?

mitigationsAndDecisionImpact.description: Which mitigations, constraints, trade-offs, or residual risks should influence prioritization, architecture, rollout, or readiness decisions?

capacityCanvas.title: Kapasiteettikanvas
capacityCanvas.purpose: How much demand, load, timing, and scaling capacity must be understood for the capability, automation, integration, or service?
capacityCanvas.howToUse: Quantify current and expected demand, peak load, and availability needs. Record caching, rate limiting, and scaling approaches as architecture follow-up decisions rather than user requirements.

currentBusinessVolumes.description: Mitkä ovat nykyiset liiketoimintavolyymit ja transaktiomäärät?

peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.description: Mitkä ovat huippukuormituksen ja saatavuuden vaatimukset?

cachingStrategies.description: Mitä välimuististrategioita voidaan käyttää suorituskyvyn optimoimiseksi?

rateLimitingStrategies.description: Mitä kutsunopeuden rajoitusstrategioita voidaan käyttää kulutuksen hallintaan?

scalingStrategies.description: Mitä skaalausstrategioita voidaan käyttää kasvun tukemiseen?

customerJourneyCanvas.title: Asiakaspolkukanvas
customerJourneyCanvas.purpose: Mikä asiakkaan tai kumppanin polku synnyttää tarpeen kyvykkyydelle tai rajapinnalle?
customerJourneyCanvas.howToUse: Kuvaa todellinen asiakkaan, kumppanin tai käyttäjän polku, ei API-rajapinnan käyttöä. Polku tuo näkyviin kipupisteet, tavoitteet ja kontekstin, jotka auttavat määrittämään kyvykkyyden ja rajapinnan vaatimukset.

pains.description: Mitkä haasteet tai ongelmat ilmenevät polun aikana?

customerNeedIsResolved.description: Miten tarve lopulta täyttyy — mahdollisesti ilman APIa?

gains.description: Mitä hyötyä tai arvoa asiakas saa lopputuloksena?

inputsOutputs.description: Mitkä asiat käynnistävät ja seuraavat eri vaiheita?

interactionProcessingRules.description: Mitkä roolit, järjestelmät tai säännöt vaikuttavat kulkuun?

domainCanvas.title: Toimialuekanvas
domainCanvas.purpose: Mitkä keskeiset käsitteet, entiteetit ja toimialueen säännöt kyvykkyyden tai rajapinnan täytyy huomioida?
domainCanvas.howToUse: Määritä toimialuemalli kyvykkyydelle tai rajapinnalle, mukaan lukien entiteetit, attribuutit ja suhteet.

selectedCustomerJourneySteps.description: Mitkä asiakaspolun vaiheet ovat olennaisia tälle toimialueelle?

coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.description: Mitkä ovat keskeiset entiteetit ja niiden liiketoiminnallinen merkitys?

attributesAndBusinessImportance.description: Mitkä ovat kunkin entiteetin keskeiset attribuutit ja niiden liiketoiminnallinen merkitys?

businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.description: Mitkä ovat entiteetteihin liittyvät liiketoiminta-, sääntely- ja eheysvaatimukset?

securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.description: Mitä tietoturvaan ja yksityisyyteen liittyviä näkökulmia entiteetteihin liittyy?

eventCanvas.title: Tapahtumakanvas
eventCanvas.purpose: Mitkä tapahtumat ovat olennaisia kyvykkyydelle tai rajapinnalle ja miten ne käsitellään?
eventCanvas.howToUse: Määritä tapahtumat, niiden laukaisijat ja käsittelylogiikka kyvykkyydelle tai rajapinnalle.

userTaskTrigger.description: Mikä käyttäjän toiminto tai järjestelmätapahtuma laukaisee tämän tapahtuman?

inputEventPayload.description: Mitä tietoja saapuva tapahtumakuorma sisältää? Määrittele keskeiset attribuutit.

processingLogic.description: Kuvaile taustajärjestelmän käsittelylogiikka mukaan lukien validoinnit, muunnokset ja reitityspäätökset.

outputEventResult.description: Mikä tapahtuma tai kuittaus syntyy? Sisällytä vastauksen attribuutit.

interactionCanvas.title: Vuorovaikutuskanvas
interactionCanvas.purpose: Minkä tyyppisiä vuorovaikutuksia kyvykkyyden tai rajapinnan täytyy tukea ennen protokollakohtaisen suunnittelun valintaa?
interactionCanvas.howToUse: Tunnista, mitä vuorovaikutustyylejä todella tarvitaan ja mitkä jäävät rajauksen ulkopuolelle. Käytä kanvasta tarkoituksen selkeyttämiseen ennen kuin ratkaisu mallinnetaan REST-, tapahtuma- tai GraphQL-toteutukseksi.

crudInputOutputModels.description: Mitkä ovat CRUD-vuorovaikutusten syötteet ja vastaukset, jos tätä tyyliä tarvitaan?

crudProcessingValidation.description: Mitkä ovat CRUD-vuorovaikutusten käsittely- ja validointisäännöt, jos tätä tyyliä tarvitaan?

queryDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Mitkä ovat kyselyohjattujen vuorovaikutusten syötteet ja vastaukset?

queryDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Mitkä ovat kyselyohjattujen vuorovaikutusten käsittely- ja validointisäännöt?

commandDrivenInteractions.description: Mitä tilaa muuttavia komentoja tarvitaan, jos niitä tarvitaan?

eventDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Mitkä ovat tapahtumapohjaisten vuorovaikutusten syötteet ja vastaukset, jos tätä tyyliä tarvitaan?

eventDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Mitkä ovat tapahtumapohjaisten vuorovaikutusten käsittely- ja validointisäännöt, jos tätä tyyliä tarvitaan?

locationsCanvas.title: Sijaintikanvas
locationsCanvas.purpose: Mitkä geopoliittiset, sääntelyyn liittyvät, verkko- ja luottamusrajat vaikuttavat tähän kyvykkyyteen tai rajapintaan?
locationsCanvas.howToUse: Tunnista, missä hyödyntäjät, tuottajat ja riippuvat järjestelmät toimivat sisäverkoissa, kumppaniverkoissa, julkisessa internetissä ja säännellyillä alueilla. Kuvaa vaikutukset latenssiin, luottamukseen, vaatimustenmukaisuuteen ja yhteyksiin.

locationGroups.description: Mitkä ovat merkitykselliset geopoliittiset, sääntely-, verkko- tai luottamusryhmät?

locationGroupCharacteristics.description: Mitkä ovat näiden ryhmien ominaisuudet, kuten sijainti, luottamustaso tai verkkoaltistuminen?

locations.description: Mitkä ovat kunkin ryhmän merkittävät sijainnit, vyöhykkeet tai ympäristöt?

locationCharacteristics.description: Mitkä ovat kyseisten sijaintien tai vyöhykkeiden ominaisuudet, kuten omistajuus, alue tai altistuminen?

locationDistances.description: Mitä viive-, luottamus-, sääntely- tai yhteysetäisyyksiä sijaintien välillä on?

locationDistanceCharacteristics.description: Mitkä ovat näiden etäisyyksien ominaisuudet, kuten viiveherkkyys, sijaintirajoitukset tai luottamusrajat?

locationEndpoints.description: Mitkä yhteyspäätepisteet tai rajapinnat liittyvät sijainteihin?

locationEndpointCharacteristics.description: Mitkä ovat näiden päätepisteiden ominaisuudet, kuten altistuminen, protokolla, turvallisuus tai käyttörajoitukset?
