restCanvas.purpose: Miten API voidaan suunnitella REST-periaatteiden mukaisesti?
restCanvas.howToUse: Määrittele APIn resurssit, verbit sekä esimerkkipyynnöt ja -vastaukset.

apiResources.description: Mitkä ovat keskeiset resurssit, joita API paljastaa?

apiVerbs.description: Mitä HTTP-verbejä käytetään APIn resurssien kanssa vuorovaikutuksessa?

apiVerbExample.description: Anna esimerkki API-pyynnöstä ja -vastauksesta kullekin verbille.

graphqlCanvas.title: GraphQL-kanvas
graphqlCanvas.purpose: Miten API voidaan suunnitella GraphQL-periaatteiden mukaisesti?
graphqlCanvas.howToUse: Määritä GraphQL-API-rajapinnan keskeiset tyypit, kyselyt, mutaatiot ja rajoitteet.

apiName.description: Mikä on GraphQL-API:n tai päätepisteen nimi?

consumerGoals.description: Mitä ongelmia API:n käyttäjät yrittävät ratkaista? Mitä dataa he tarvitsevat?

keyTypes.description: Mitkä ovat keskeiset tyypit (esim. User, Order, Product)?

relationships.description: Miten tyypit liittyvät toisiinsa sisäkkäisissä kyselyissä?

mutations.description: Mitkä toiminnot muuttavat dataa (esim. luonti, päivitys, poisto)?

subscriptions.description: Onko reaaliaikaisia päivityksiä tai tapahtumia, joita voi tilata?

authorizationRules.description: Kuka voi käyttää mitäkin kenttiä tai tyyppejä?

consumerConstraints.description: Onko sivutukseen, suodatukseen tai nopeusrajoihin liittyviä rajoitteita?

openQuestions.description: Onko keskeneräisiä päätöksiä tai integraatioon liittyviä huomioita?

capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.title: Kyvykkyyden arvolupauskanvas
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Mikä uudelleenkäytettävä kyvykkyys loisi arvoa hyödyntäjille ilman, että vielä päätetään toteutetaanko se API-rajapintana, tapahtumana, tiedostona, streamina, datatuotteena tai muuna integraatiotyylinä?
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Aloita hyödyntäjien tehtävistä ja lopputuloksista. Kuvaa hyödyt mahdollistavat ja kipupisteitä vähentävät kyvykkyyden ominaisuudet. Määritä sen jälkeen mahdolliset uudelleenkäytettävät kyvykkyydet nimeämättä teknologiaa liian aikaisin.

consumerTasks.description: Mitä hyödyntäjät, kumppanit, käyttäjät, järjestelmät tai tiimit yrittävät saavuttaa?

gainEnablingCapabilities.description: Mitkä kyvykkyyden ominaisuudet auttaisivat hyödyntäjiä saavuttamaan parempia tuloksia, nopeutta, automaatiota, oivalluksia, kattavuutta tai vaatimustenmukaisuutta?

painRelievingCapabilities.description: Mitkä kyvykkyyden ominaisuudet poistaisivat kitkaa, manuaalista työtä, virheitä, viiveitä, riskejä tai epävarmuutta hyödyntäjiltä?

reusableCapabilities.description: Mitkä uudelleenkäytettävät liiketoiminta- tai datakyvykkyydet voisivat palvella näitä tehtäviä, hyötyjä ja kipupisteitä useamman kuin yhden hyödyntäjän tai käyttötapauksen tarpeisiin?

capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.title: Kyvykkyyden liiketoimintamallikanvas
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Kuinka elinkelpoinen, uudelleenkäytettävä, rahoitettu, omistettu, tuettu ja löydettävä tämän integraatiokyvykkyyden tulisi olla?
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Tiivistä kyvykkyyden arvolupaus, tunnista hyödyntäjät ja osallistamiskanavat sekä kartoita omistajuus, toiminnot, resurssit, kumppanit, hyödyt ja kustannukset.

keyPartners.description: Mitä liiketoiminnan, teknologian, datan, turvallisuuden, juridiikan, alustan tai ulkoisia kumppaneita tarvitaan, jotta kyvykkyys toimii?

keyActivities.description: Mitä kyvykkyyden omistajan ja tuottajien täytyy tehdä kyvykkyyden suunnittelemiseksi, toimittamiseksi, hallitsemiseksi, tukemiseksi ja parantamiseksi?

keyResources.description: Mitä järjestelmiä, data-aineistoja, alustoja, ihmisiä, standardeja, rahoitusta ja operatiivisia kyvykkyyksiä tarvitaan?

capabilityValueProposition.description: Mitä arvoa tämä uudelleenkäytettävä kyvykkyys tuottaa hyödyntäjille sekä organisaatiolle tai ekosysteemille?

consumerEngagement.description: Miten hyödyntäjät löytävät, arvioivat, pyytävät käyttöönsä, ottavat käyttöön, saavat tukea ja antavat palautetta kyvykkyydestä?

channels.description: Minkä katalogien, portaalien, markkinapaikkojen, dokumentaatiosivustojen, tukikanavien tai governance-prosessien kautta hyödyntäjät ovat vuorovaikutuksessa kyvykkyyden kanssa?

capabilityConsumerSegments.description: Ketkä ovat kyvykkyyden nykyisiä ja mahdollisia hyödyntäjiä, mukaan lukien tiimit, kumppanit, järjestelmät, tuotteet tai datan käyttäjät?

costs.description: Mitkä ovat kyvykkyyden rakentamisen, operoinnin, governancen, tuen ja kehittämisen merkittävät kustannukset?

benefits.description: Mitkä liiketoiminnalliset, operatiiviset, ekosysteemiin, uudelleenkäyttöön, vaatimustenmukaisuuteen tai kustannuksiin liittyvät hyödyt perustelevat kyvykkyyden?

consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.title: Experience Requirements Canvas
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.purpose: What experience, operational, and non-functional requirements must the solution satisfy for users, operators, consumers, approvers, and support teams?
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.howToUse: Capture what people and consuming systems require from the capability or automation. Keep this focused on requirements and constraints; quantify capacity and choose implementation mechanisms in later architecture work.

consumerGoals.description: What business, workflow, decision, automation, support, or data usage goals must be supported?

availabilityAndTimeliness.description: When must the solution be available, how fresh must information be, and what response, delivery, or completion windows matter to users and operators?

volumeAndPerformance.description: What user, case, transaction, record, event, file, batch, or work-item volumes must be understood before capacity planning?

dataQualityAndConsistency.description: What accuracy, completeness, consistency, ordering, deduplication, reconciliation, or validation expectations do users, operators, or consuming systems have?

securityPrivacyAndCompliance.description: What identity, authorization, confidentiality, residency, consent, retention, audit, or regulatory constraints must the solution satisfy?

onboardingAndAccess.description: How do users, operators, or consuming teams gain access, initiate or participate in the solution, and receive the required permissions and guidance?

changeAndVersioning.description: How much change tolerance exists, and what notice, compatibility, migration, training, or versioning expectations apply?

observabilityAndSupport.description: What monitoring, status, traceability, quality visibility, support, ownership, and incident communication do users and operators need?

recoveryAndContinuity.description: What replay, retry, reconciliation, backup, fallback, continuity, or manual recovery expectations must be supported?

architectureImplications.description: Which requirements must later architecture, workflow, capacity, integration, or implementation decisions satisfy?

automationOpportunityCanvas.title: Automation Hypothesis Canvas
automationOpportunityCanvas.purpose: Link evidence from optional supporting canvases to a testable automation hypothesis before committing to architecture or delivery.
automationOpportunityCanvas.howToUse: Start with the Automation Hypothesis Canvas. Reference Journey, Value Proposition, Domain, Business Impact, Capacity, or other evidence only where it is relevant; do not repeat those canvases here.

hypothesis.description: What do we believe automating which work for which actor will achieve? Use the form: We believe automating [work] for [actor] will achieve [outcome].

supportingEvidence.description: Which Journey, Value Proposition, Business Impact, Capacity, Domain, or other evidence supports this hypothesis? Link or reference existing artifacts instead of repeating them.

automationScope.description: Which part of the work is being considered for automation now, and what is explicitly outside scope?

responsibilityAndSolutionHypothesis.description: What is the current assumption about how the automation might be implemented? This is an assumption to validate, not an architecture decision.

criticalAssumptions.description: Which assumptions could invalidate value, feasibility, safety, operability, compliance, or adoption?

validationExperiment.description: What is the smallest useful PoC or investigation, what evidence and thresholds decide success, and what stop conditions apply?

decision.description: What is the evidence-based decision: supported, revise and retest, redesign the process first, or reject?

humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.title: Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.purpose: Decide what should be performed by people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, or UI automation.
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.howToUse: List target process steps and decide the most appropriate performer for each step. Capture required oversight, escalation, and evidence so the solution does not assume every step should be automated.

processStep.description: Which step in the target process is being assigned or reviewed?

humanResponsibility.description: What should a person do, decide, approve, review, correct, or own?

ruleOrWorkflowResponsibility.description: What can be handled by deterministic rules, orchestration, routing, reminders, or scheduled workflow?

agentOrAiResponsibility.description: What judgement, language, classification, generation, planning, or assistance may an agent or AI perform?

apiOrSystemResponsibility.description: What should be performed through system capability, API, event, connector, file, or direct integration?

rpaOrUiAutomationResponsibility.description: Where is UI automation justified because no suitable system, API, event, connector, or data access path exists?

requiredOversight.description: What human supervision, approval, confirmation, monitoring, or review is required before or after the step?

escalation.description: When should the step stop, ask for help, route to a person, or move to another support path?

evidenceOrAuditTrail.description: What record proves what happened, who or what acted, what data was used, and what decision was made?

automationWorkflowCanvas.title: Automation Workflow Canvas
automationWorkflowCanvas.purpose: Design the sequence, states, data, triggers, decisions, interactions, failure paths, and recovery for the end-to-end automation workflow.
automationWorkflowCanvas.howToUse: Use the responsibility allocation from the Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas as an input. Focus here on how the workflow runs, changes state, exchanges data, handles exceptions, produces evidence, and recovers.

trigger.description: What event, schedule, user action, message, data change, or manual request starts the automation?

inputs.description: What data, documents, messages, forms, records, or context are required at the start and during the workflow?

workflowStages.description: What are the main workflow stages and states from trigger to completion, including waiting, review, exception, and completion states?

decisionsAndRules.description: Which deterministic rules, validations, thresholds, policies, or decision points shape the flow?

agentActions.description: What may the automation, workflow, rule, agent, integration, API, RPA, or system component do at each relevant stage?

systemInteractions.description: Which systems, APIs, events, connectors, custom components, files, or screens are called or updated?

dataSources.description: Which source systems, datasets, records, documents, or knowledge sources are used and trusted?

humanTasks.description: Where does the responsibility allocation require approval, confirmation, judgement, correction, review, or manual completion?

handoffs.description: Where does work move between automation components, people, support teams, systems, queues, or exception paths?

exceptions.description: What error, missing-data, conflicting-data, timeout, permission, unsafe-action, or business exception scenarios must be handled?

retriesAndTimeouts.description: Where are retries, timeout limits, duplicate prevention, idempotency, pause rules, or compensation required?

outputs.description: What records, decisions, messages, documents, updates, notifications, or outcomes are produced?

auditEvidence.description: What log, trace, approval, run history, input snapshot, output record, or explanation proves correct operation?

monitoringPoints.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, quality, safety, or outcome metrics should be observed?

recoveryPath.description: How can the process be paused, rolled back, compensated, rerun, corrected, or completed manually?

automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.title: Automation Architecture Decision Canvas
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.purpose: Compare and justify alternative implementation mechanisms for an automation solution.
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.howToUse: Mark each candidate mechanism as considered, selected, rejected, or not relevant. Compare only the viable candidates individually and as a hybrid, then justify the recommended implementation approach using feasibility, reliability, security, maintainability, latency, scalability, cost, dependency, testability, observability, recoverability, skills, and architectural fit.

nativeFeature.description: Can an existing system capability solve this step with acceptable reliability, controls, and ownership?

workflow.description: Where is workflow orchestration, scheduling, routing, approval, notification, or coordination the best fit?

rule.description: Which decisions can be implemented as deterministic business rules, policy checks, validations, or calculations?

agent.description: Where could an agent or AI safely add judgement, language understanding, generation, planning, or assistance?

connector.description: Which low-code, platform, SaaS, file, message, or data connectors are viable?

api.description: Where is an API call the best fit for reliable, governed, testable system interaction?

event.description: Where should the solution react to, publish, or consume events?

customCode.description: Where is custom code justified because standard capabilities are insufficient or too risky?

rpa.description: Where is desktop or UI automation justified, and what fragility or recovery controls are required?

humanTask.description: Which steps should remain human because of judgement, accountability, risk, consent, policy, or exception handling?

feasibilityReliabilitySecurity.description: How do candidates compare on technical feasibility, expected reliability, identity, authorization, data exposure, and control strength?

maintainabilityScalabilityCost.description: How do candidates compare on change effort, operating cost, licence cost, transaction volume, peak load, and lifecycle maintenance?

latencyObservabilityRecoverability.description: How do candidates compare on timing needs, monitoring, logs, traceability, retry, compensation, and manual recovery?

skillsVendorFit.description: What skills, ownership, platform dependencies, governance constraints, and architecture standards affect the decision?

recommendedHybridApproach.description: Which combination of people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, events, custom code, and UI automation should be used?

decisionRationale.description: Why is this approach preferred over the alternatives, and what evidence supports the decision?

openQuestionsAndRisks.description: Which assumptions, risks, dependencies, or unresolved constraints must be validated before delivery or release?

automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.title: Automation Readiness & Operations Canvas
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.purpose: Prepare the operating model for a safely released, supported, monitored, and recoverable automation.
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.howToUse: Use this during delivery to prepare ownership, environments, access, evidence, monitoring, support, fallback, rollback, runbooks, known risks, and the deployment decision. Use the readiness checklist later for the release gate.

businessOwner.description: Who accepts business value, process impact, residual risk, and release timing?

operationalOwner.description: Who owns runtime supervision, incidents, support, runbooks, changes, and recovery?

users.description: Which users, operators, approvers, support teams, or process participants are affected?

permissions.description: What human, service, system, data, role, and approval permissions are required and approved?

credentials.description: How are credentials, secrets, certificates, tokens, delegated access, and service identities managed?

environments.description: Which development, test, staging, production, desktop, cloud, or platform environments are used?

testEvidence.description: What proves functional correctness, rule behavior, integration behavior, agent behavior, permissions, performance, and exceptions?

exceptionHandling.description: How are errors, missing data, unsafe actions, failed runs, retries, timeouts, and handoffs handled?

monitoring.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, value, safety, and outcome signals are monitored?

support.description: Who supports users and operators, how are incidents raised, and what service expectations apply?

manualFallback.description: How can work continue manually if the automation is paused, unavailable, incorrect, or unsafe?

rollback.description: How can changes, actions, data updates, releases, or workflow versions be reversed or compensated?

documentation.description: What operating instructions, design records, architecture decisions, user guidance, and runbooks are ready?

deploymentDecision.description: What remains incomplete, conditional, or blocking before the formal readiness decision?

knownRisks.description: Which risks are accepted, mitigated, deferred, or blocking release?

improvementBacklog.description: Which improvements, unresolved assumptions, PoC findings, and future enhancements should be prioritized next?

apiBusinessModelCanvas.title: API Business Model Canvas
apiBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Quelle sera la viabilité et la réutilisabilité de cette API ? Existe-t-il un modèle métier justifié du point de vue coût-bénéfice ?
apiBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Résumer la proposition de valeur d’une API à partir de l’API Value Proposition Canvas, puis suivre la séquence numérotée.

keyPartners.description: Qui sont les principales parties prenantes impliquées?

keyActivities.description: Quelles sont les actions les plus importantes que le fournisseur d’API doit entreprendre pour réussir?

keyResources.description: Quels actifs stratégiques uniques le fournisseur d’API doit-il acquérir ou développer?

apiValueProposition.description: Commencez par une note adhésive indiquant le nom de l’API ou de la famille d’API, puis notez la valeur ajoutée que l’API offre aux utilisateurs API.

developerRelations.description: Comment le fournisseur d’API atteint-il et soutient-il les utilisateurs API?

channels.description: Par quels mécanismes les utilisateurs API interagissent-ils avec l’API?

apiConsumerSegments.description: Quelles sont les audiences cibles pour l’API?

costs.description: Quels sont les coûts importants liés à la création, au déploiement et à l'exploitation de l’API?

benefits.description: Quels sont les avantages significatifs ou les sources de revenus générés par l’API?

apiValuePropositionCanvas.title: API Value Proposition Canvas
apiValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Comment le parcours client est-il lié aux API ? Quels irritants et gains des utilisateurs finaux et des utilisateurs API doivent être traités ?
apiValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Décrire la perspective des utilisateurs finaux, en commençant par leurs tâches, puis leurs irritants et gains ainsi que ceux des utilisateurs API, et enfin les produits et fonctionnalités API.

tasks.description: Que cherchent à accomplir les clients ou utilisateurs finaux ?

gainEnablingFeatures.description: Quelles fonctionnalités aident les utilisateurs finaux et les utilisateurs API à obtenir les gains attendus ?

painRelievingFeatures.description: Quelles fonctionnalités aident les utilisateurs finaux et les utilisateurs API à réduire les irritants ?

apiProducts.description: Quels produits et fonctionnalités API répondent aux tâches, peines et gains?

businessImpactCanvas.title: Business Impact Canvas
businessImpactCanvas.purpose: What value, risk, operational, financial, customer, employee, compliance, and strategic impact is expected or at stake?
businessImpactCanvas.howToUse: Use this to connect expected benefits and consequences to architecture, prioritization, readiness, and proceed-or-stop decisions. Include the impact of not proceeding as well as critical risks and mitigations.

availabilityRisks.description: Quels sont les risques potentiels pour la disponibilité de l’API?

securityRisks.description: Quels sont les risques de sécurité potentiels associés à l’API?

dataRisks.description: Quels sont les risques potententiels pour l'intégrité ou la protection des données?

mitigateAvailabilityRisks.description: Comment le fournisseur d’API peut-il atténuer les risques de disponibilité?

mitigateSecurityRisks.description: Comment le fournisseur d’API peut-il atténuer les risques de sécurité?

mitigateDataRisks.section: Atténuer les risques liés aux données
mitigateDataRisks.description: Comment le fournisseur d’API peut-il atténuer les risques liés aux données?

expectedBenefits.description: What business, customer, employee, quality, speed, risk, compliance, or strategic benefits are expected?

operationalEfficiencyImpact.description: How could work effort, waiting time, rework, throughput, reliability, support load, or operational cost change?

customerEmployeeImpact.description: How will customers, employees, partners, operators, or support teams experience the change?

financialImpact.description: What revenue, cost, investment, savings, loss avoidance, or funding impact is expected?

complianceStrategicImpact.description: What regulatory, contractual, policy, reputation, market, ecosystem, or strategic consequences matter?

impactOfNotProceeding.description: What happens if the capability, automation, integration, or service is not improved or delivered?

risksAndCriticality.description: What availability, security, data, safety, process, adoption, or business continuity risks could affect the outcome?

mitigationsAndDecisionImpact.description: Which mitigations, constraints, trade-offs, or residual risks should influence prioritization, architecture, rollout, or readiness decisions?

capacityCanvas.title: Capacity Canvas
capacityCanvas.purpose: How much demand, load, timing, and scaling capacity must be understood for the capability, automation, integration, or service?
capacityCanvas.howToUse: Quantify current and expected demand, peak load, and availability needs. Record caching, rate limiting, and scaling approaches as architecture follow-up decisions rather than user requirements.

currentBusinessVolumes.description: Quels sont les volumes d'affaires et taux de transaction actuels?

futureConsumptionTrends.description: Quelles sont les tendances de consommation anticipées?

peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.section: Exigences de charge maximale et de disponibilité
peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.description: Quelles sont les exigences de charge maximale et de disponibilité?

cachingStrategies.description: Quelles stratégies de mise en cache peuvent être utilisées pour optimiser les performances?

rateLimitingStrategies.description: Quelles stratégies de limitation de débit peuvent être utilisées pour gérer la consommation?

scalingStrategies.description: Quelles stratégies d'évolutivité peuvent être utilisées pour accompagner la croissance?

customerJourneyCanvas.title: Customer Journey Canvas
customerJourneyCanvas.purpose: Quel parcours client ou partenaire crée le besoin de capacité ou d’interface ?
customerJourneyCanvas.howToUse: Décrire un parcours réel de client, partenaire ou utilisateur, et non l’usage de l’API elle-même. Ce parcours révèle les irritants, objectifs et contextes qui aident à définir les exigences de capacité et d’interface.

customerDiscoversNeed.description: Comment le client reconnaît-il son besoin ou son problème?

persona.description: Qui est le client type qui vit ce parcours?

pains.description: Quels sont les irritants ou défis du client?

journeySteps.description: Quelles sont les étapes suivies par le client dans son parcours?

customerNeedIsResolved.section: Le besoin du client est résolu
customerNeedIsResolved.description: Comment le besoin du client est-il finalement résolu?

gains.description: Quels sont les gains ou bénéfices pour le client?

inputsOutputs.description: Quelles sont les entrées et les sorties à chaque étape?

interactionProcessingRules.description: Quelles sont les règles d'interaction et de traitement à chaque étape?

domainCanvas.title: Domain Canvas
domainCanvas.purpose: Quels concepts, entités et règles de domaine métier la capacité ou l’interface doit-elle respecter ?
domainCanvas.howToUse: Définir le modèle de domaine métier pour la capacité ou l’interface, y compris entités, attributs et relations.

selectedCustomerJourneySteps.description: Quelles étapes du parcours client sont pertinentes pour ce domaine?

coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.description: Quelles sont les entités principales et leur signification métier?

attributesAndBusinessImportance.description: Quels sont les attributs clés de chaque entité et leur importance métier?

relationshipsBetweenEntities.description: Quelles sont les relations entre les entités?

businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.description: Quelles sont les règles métier, de conformité et d'intégrité liées aux entités?

securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.section: Considérations de sécurité et de confidentialité
securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.description: Quelles sont les considérations de sécurité et de confidentialité liées aux entités?

eventCanvas.title: Event Canvas
eventCanvas.purpose: Quels événements sont pertinents pour la capacité ou l’interface, et comment sont-ils traités ?
eventCanvas.howToUse: Définir les événements, leurs déclencheurs et la logique de traitement pour la capacité ou l’interface.

userTaskTrigger.description: Quelle action utilisateur ou événement système déclenche cette opération d'événement?

inputEventPayload.description: Quelles données sont incluses dans la charge utile de l'événement entrant? Spécifiez les attributs clés.

processingLogic.description: Décrivez la logique de traitement systèmes backend, y compris les validations, transformations ou décisions de routage.

outputEventResult.description: Quel événement ou accusé de réception est produit? Incluez les attributs de la charge utile de sortie.

interactionCanvas.title: Interaction Canvas
interactionCanvas.purpose: Quels types d’interactions cette capacité ou interface doit-elle prendre en charge avant de choisir une conception propre au protocole ?
interactionCanvas.howToUse: Identifier les styles d’interaction réellement nécessaires et ceux qui sont hors périmètre. Utiliser ce canvas pour clarifier l’intention avant de mapper le résultat vers REST, événements ou GraphQL.

crudInteractions.description: Quelles interactions CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) sont-elles nécessaires ici?

crudInputOutputModels.section: Modèles d'entrée et de sortie CRUD
crudInputOutputModels.description: Quels sont les modèles d'entrée et de sortie pour les interactions CRUD, si ce style est nécessaire ?

crudProcessingValidation.description: QQuelles sont les règles de traitement et de validation pour les interactions CRUD, si ce style est nécessaire ?

queryDrivenInteractions.description: Quelles interactions de lecture ou de requête sont nécessaires pour répondre aux questions des utilisateurs ?

queryDrivenInputOutputModels.section: Modèles d'entrée et de sortie pilotés par les requêtes
queryDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Quels sont les modèles d'entrée et de sortie pour les interactions pilotées par les requêtes ?

queryDrivenProcessingValidation.section: Traitement et validation pilotés par les requêtes
queryDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Quelles sont les règles de traitement et de validation pour les interactions pilotées par les requêtes ?

commandDrivenInteractions.description: Quelles commandes modifiant l'état sont nécessaires, le cas échéant ?

commandDrivenInputOutputModels.section: Modèles d'entrée et de sortie pilotés par commande
commandDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Quels sont les modèles d'entrée et de sortie pour les interactions pilotées par commande, si ce style est nécessaire ?

commandDrivenProcessingValidation.section: Traitement et validation pilotés par les commandes
commandDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Quelles sont les règles de traitement et de validation pour les interactions pilotées par les commandes, si ce style est nécessaire ?

eventDrivenInteractions.description: Quels événements doivent être publiés ou consommés, le cas échéant ?

eventDrivenInputOutputModels.section: Modèles d'entrée et de sortie pilotés par les événements
eventDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Modèles d'entrée et de sortie pilotés par les événements

eventDrivenProcessingValidation.section: Traitement et validation pilotés par les événements
eventDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Quelles sont les règles de traitement et de validation pour les interactions pilotées par les événements, si ce style est requis ?

locationsCanvas.title: Locations Canvas
locationsCanvas.purpose: Quelles frontières géopolitiques, réglementaires, réseau et de confiance affectent cette capacité ou interface ?
locationsCanvas.howToUse: Identifier où les utilisateurs, fournisseurs et systèmes dépendants opèrent dans les réseaux internes, réseaux partenaires, Internet public et régions réglementées. Décrire les implications sur la latence, la confiance, la conformité et la connectivité.

locationGroups.description: Quels sont les groupes géopolitiques, réglementaires, de réseau ou de confiance pertinents ?

locationGroupCharacteristics.description: uelles sont les caractéristiques de ces groupes, telles que la localisation, le niveau de confiance ou l'exposition réseau ?

locations.description: Quels sont les emplacements, zones ou environnements pertinents au sein de chaque groupe ?

locationCharacteristics.description: Quelles sont les caractéristiques de ces emplacements ou zones, telles que la propriété, la région ou l'exposition ?

locationDistances.description: Quelles sont les distances en termes de latence, de confiance, de réglementation ou de connectivité entre les emplacements ?

locationDistanceCharacteristics.description: Quelles sont les caractéristiques de ces distances, telles que la sensibilité à la latence, les contraintes de résidence ou les limites de confiance ?

locationEndpoints.description: Quels sont les points de terminaison ou interfaces de connectivité associés aux emplacements ?

locationEndpointCharacteristics.section: Caractéristiques d'accès aux points de terminaison
locationEndpointCharacteristics.description: Quelles sont les caractéristiques de ces points de terminaison, telles que l'exposition, le protocole, la sécurité ou les restrictions d'accès ?

restCanvas.title: REST Canvas
restCanvas.purpose: Comment concevoir l’API selon les principes RESTful ?
restCanvas.howToUse: Définissez les ressources de l’API, les verbes et les exemples de requêtes et réponses.

apiResources.description: Quelles sont les ressources clés exposées par l’API?

apiResourceModel.description: Quelle est la structure du modèle de ressources de l’API?

apiVerbs.description: Quels verbes HTTP sont utilisés pour interagir avec les ressources de l’API?

apiVerbExample.description: Fournissez un exemple de requête et de réponse API pour chaque verbe.

graphqlCanvas.title: GraphQL Canvas
graphqlCanvas.purpose: Comment concevoir l’API selon les principes GraphQL ?
graphqlCanvas.howToUse: Définir les types clés, requêtes, mutations et contraintes pour l’API GraphQL.

apiName.description: Quel est le nom de l’API GraphQL ou du point de terminaison ?

consumerGoals.description: Quels problèmes les utilisateurs de l’API cherchent-ils à résoudre ? Quelles données leur sont nécessaires ?

keyTypes.description: Quels sont les types principaux exposés (ex. Utilisateur, Commande, Produit) ?

relationships.description: Comment les types sont-ils liés dans les requêtes imbriquées ?

queries.description: Quelles requêtes courantes doivent être prises en charge ?

mutations.description: Quelles opérations vont modifier les données (ex. créer, mettre à jour, supprimer) ?

subscriptions.description: Existe-t-il des mises à jour en temps réel ou des événements auxquels les utilisateurs peuvent s'abonner ?

authorizationRules.description: Qui peut accéder à quels champs ou types ?

consumerConstraints.description: Y a-t-il des contraintes de pagination, de filtrage ou de limitation du débit ?

openQuestions.description: Y a-t-il des décisions en attente ou des considérations d’intégration ?

capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.title: Capability Value Proposition Canvas
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Quelle capacité réutilisable créerait de la valeur pour les utilisateurs sans décider encore si elle doit être mise à disposition sous forme d’API, d’événement, de fichier, de flux, de produit de données ou d’un autre mode de mise en œuvre ?
capabilityValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Partir des tâches et résultats attendus des utilisateurs. Capturer les fonctionnalités de capacité qui créent des gains et réduisent les irritants, puis décrire les capacités réutilisables candidates sans nommer la technologie trop tôt.

consumerTasks.description: Que cherchent à accomplir les utilisateurs, partenaires, systèmes ou équipes ?

gainEnablingCapabilities.section: Fonctionnalités de capacité génératrices de gains
gainEnablingCapabilities.description: Quelles fonctionnalités de capacité aideraient les utilisateurs à obtenir de meilleurs résultats, plus de rapidité, d’automatisation, d’insights, de portée ou de conformité ?

painRelievingCapabilities.section: Fonctionnalités de capacité qui réduisent les irritants
painRelievingCapabilities.description: Quelles fonctionnalités de capacité supprimeraient les frictions, le travail manuel, les erreurs, les retards, les risques ou l’incertitude pour les utilisateurs ?

reusableCapabilities.description: Quelles capacités métier ou données réutilisables pourraient répondre à ces tâches, gains et irritants pour plusieurs utilisateurs ou cas d’usage ?

capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.title: Capability Business Model Canvas
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Dans quelle mesure cette capacité d’intégration doit-elle être viable, réutilisable, financée, possédée, accompagnée et découvrable ?
capabilityBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Résumer la proposition de valeur de la capacité, identifier les utilisateurs et canaux d’engagement, puis cartographier propriété, activités, ressources, partenaires, bénéfices et coûts.

keyPartners.description: Quels partenaires métier, technologie, données, sécurité, juridique, plateforme ou externes sont nécessaires pour faire fonctionner la capacité ?

keyActivities.description: Que doivent faire le responsable de la capacité et les producteurs pour concevoir, mettre à disposition, gouverner, accompagner et améliorer la capacité ?

keyResources.description: Quels systèmes, actifs de données, plateformes, personnes, standards, financements et capacités opérationnelles sont nécessaires ?

capabilityValueProposition.section: Proposition de valeur de la capacité
capabilityValueProposition.description: Quelle valeur cette capacité réutilisable apporte-t-elle aux utilisateurs et à l’organisation ou à l’écosystème ?

consumerEngagement.description: Comment les utilisateurs découvriront-ils, évalueront-ils, demanderont-ils, onboarderont-ils, obtiendront-ils du support et donneront-ils du feedback sur la capacité ?

channels.description: Par quels catalogues, portails, marketplaces, sites de documentation, parcours de support ou processus de gouvernance les utilisateurs interagiront-ils avec la capacité ?

capabilityConsumerSegments.description: Qui sont les utilisateurs actuels et potentiels de la capacité, y compris équipes, partenaires, systèmes, produits ou utilisateurs de données ?

costs.description: Quels sont les coûts significatifs de construction, d’exploitation, de gouvernance, de support et d’évolution de la capacité ?

benefits.description: Quels bénéfices métier, opérationnels, écosystémiques, de réutilisation, de conformité ou de coût justifient la capacité ?

consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.title: Experience Requirements Canvas
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.purpose: What experience, operational, and non-functional requirements must the solution satisfy for users, operators, consumers, approvers, and support teams?
consumerExperienceRequirementsCanvas.howToUse: Capture what people and consuming systems require from the capability or automation. Keep this focused on requirements and constraints; quantify capacity and choose implementation mechanisms in later architecture work.

consumerGoals.description: What business, workflow, decision, automation, support, or data usage goals must be supported?

availabilityAndTimeliness.description: When must the solution be available, how fresh must information be, and what response, delivery, or completion windows matter to users and operators?

volumeAndPerformance.description: What user, case, transaction, record, event, file, batch, or work-item volumes must be understood before capacity planning?

dataQualityAndConsistency.description: What accuracy, completeness, consistency, ordering, deduplication, reconciliation, or validation expectations do users, operators, or consuming systems have?

securityPrivacyAndCompliance.description: What identity, authorization, confidentiality, residency, consent, retention, audit, or regulatory constraints must the solution satisfy?

onboardingAndAccess.description: How do users, operators, or consuming teams gain access, initiate or participate in the solution, and receive the required permissions and guidance?

changeAndVersioning.description: How much change tolerance exists, and what notice, compatibility, migration, training, or versioning expectations apply?

observabilityAndSupport.description: What monitoring, status, traceability, quality visibility, support, ownership, and incident communication do users and operators need?

recoveryAndContinuity.description: What replay, retry, reconciliation, backup, fallback, continuity, or manual recovery expectations must be supported?

architectureImplications.description: Which requirements must later architecture, workflow, capacity, integration, or implementation decisions satisfy?

automationOpportunityCanvas.title: Automation Hypothesis Canvas
automationOpportunityCanvas.purpose: Link evidence from optional supporting canvases to a testable automation hypothesis before committing to architecture or delivery.
automationOpportunityCanvas.howToUse: Start with the Automation Hypothesis Canvas. Reference Journey, Value Proposition, Domain, Business Impact, Capacity, or other evidence only where it is relevant; do not repeat those canvases here.

hypothesis.description: What do we believe automating which work for which actor will achieve? Use the form: We believe automating [work] for [actor] will achieve [outcome].

supportingEvidence.description: Which Journey, Value Proposition, Business Impact, Capacity, Domain, or other evidence supports this hypothesis? Link or reference existing artifacts instead of repeating them.

automationScope.description: Which part of the work is being considered for automation now, and what is explicitly outside scope?

responsibilityAndSolutionHypothesis.description: What is the current assumption about how the automation might be implemented? This is an assumption to validate, not an architecture decision.

criticalAssumptions.description: Which assumptions could invalidate value, feasibility, safety, operability, compliance, or adoption?

validationExperiment.description: What is the smallest useful PoC or investigation, what evidence and thresholds decide success, and what stop conditions apply?

decision.description: What is the evidence-based decision: supported, revise and retest, redesign the process first, or reject?

humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.title: Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.purpose: Decide what should be performed by people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, or UI automation.
humanAutomationResponsibilityCanvas.howToUse: List target process steps and decide the most appropriate performer for each step. Capture required oversight, escalation, and evidence so the solution does not assume every step should be automated.

processStep.description: Which step in the target process is being assigned or reviewed?

humanResponsibility.description: What should a person do, decide, approve, review, correct, or own?

ruleOrWorkflowResponsibility.description: What can be handled by deterministic rules, orchestration, routing, reminders, or scheduled workflow?

agentOrAiResponsibility.description: What judgement, language, classification, generation, planning, or assistance may an agent or AI perform?

apiOrSystemResponsibility.description: What should be performed through system capability, API, event, connector, file, or direct integration?

rpaOrUiAutomationResponsibility.description: Where is UI automation justified because no suitable system, API, event, connector, or data access path exists?

requiredOversight.description: What human supervision, approval, confirmation, monitoring, or review is required before or after the step?

escalation.description: When should the step stop, ask for help, route to a person, or move to another support path?

evidenceOrAuditTrail.description: What record proves what happened, who or what acted, what data was used, and what decision was made?

automationWorkflowCanvas.title: Automation Workflow Canvas
automationWorkflowCanvas.purpose: Design the sequence, states, data, triggers, decisions, interactions, failure paths, and recovery for the end-to-end automation workflow.
automationWorkflowCanvas.howToUse: Use the responsibility allocation from the Human-Automation Responsibility Canvas as an input. Focus here on how the workflow runs, changes state, exchanges data, handles exceptions, produces evidence, and recovers.

trigger.description: What event, schedule, user action, message, data change, or manual request starts the automation?

inputs.description: What data, documents, messages, forms, records, or context are required at the start and during the workflow?

workflowStages.description: What are the main workflow stages and states from trigger to completion, including waiting, review, exception, and completion states?

decisionsAndRules.description: Which deterministic rules, validations, thresholds, policies, or decision points shape the flow?

agentActions.description: What may the automation, workflow, rule, agent, integration, API, RPA, or system component do at each relevant stage?

systemInteractions.description: Which systems, APIs, events, connectors, custom components, files, or screens are called or updated?

dataSources.description: Which source systems, datasets, records, documents, or knowledge sources are used and trusted?

humanTasks.description: Where does the responsibility allocation require approval, confirmation, judgement, correction, review, or manual completion?

handoffs.description: Where does work move between automation components, people, support teams, systems, queues, or exception paths?

exceptions.description: What error, missing-data, conflicting-data, timeout, permission, unsafe-action, or business exception scenarios must be handled?

retriesAndTimeouts.description: Where are retries, timeout limits, duplicate prevention, idempotency, pause rules, or compensation required?

outputs.description: What records, decisions, messages, documents, updates, notifications, or outcomes are produced?

auditEvidence.description: What log, trace, approval, run history, input snapshot, output record, or explanation proves correct operation?

monitoringPoints.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, quality, safety, or outcome metrics should be observed?

recoveryPath.description: How can the process be paused, rolled back, compensated, rerun, corrected, or completed manually?

automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.title: Automation Architecture Decision Canvas
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.purpose: Compare and justify alternative implementation mechanisms for an automation solution.
automationArchitectureDecisionCanvas.howToUse: Mark each candidate mechanism as considered, selected, rejected, or not relevant. Compare only the viable candidates individually and as a hybrid, then justify the recommended implementation approach using feasibility, reliability, security, maintainability, latency, scalability, cost, dependency, testability, observability, recoverability, skills, and architectural fit.

nativeFeature.description: Can an existing system capability solve this step with acceptable reliability, controls, and ownership?

workflow.description: Where is workflow orchestration, scheduling, routing, approval, notification, or coordination the best fit?

rule.description: Which decisions can be implemented as deterministic business rules, policy checks, validations, or calculations?

agent.description: Where could an agent or AI safely add judgement, language understanding, generation, planning, or assistance?

connector.description: Which low-code, platform, SaaS, file, message, or data connectors are viable?

api.description: Where is an API call the best fit for reliable, governed, testable system interaction?

event.description: Where should the solution react to, publish, or consume events?

customCode.description: Where is custom code justified because standard capabilities are insufficient or too risky?

rpa.description: Where is desktop or UI automation justified, and what fragility or recovery controls are required?

humanTask.description: Which steps should remain human because of judgement, accountability, risk, consent, policy, or exception handling?

feasibilityReliabilitySecurity.description: How do candidates compare on technical feasibility, expected reliability, identity, authorization, data exposure, and control strength?

maintainabilityScalabilityCost.description: How do candidates compare on change effort, operating cost, licence cost, transaction volume, peak load, and lifecycle maintenance?

latencyObservabilityRecoverability.description: How do candidates compare on timing needs, monitoring, logs, traceability, retry, compensation, and manual recovery?

skillsVendorFit.description: What skills, ownership, platform dependencies, governance constraints, and architecture standards affect the decision?

recommendedHybridApproach.description: Which combination of people, rules, workflows, agents, systems, APIs, events, custom code, and UI automation should be used?

decisionRationale.description: Why is this approach preferred over the alternatives, and what evidence supports the decision?

openQuestionsAndRisks.description: Which assumptions, risks, dependencies, or unresolved constraints must be validated before delivery or release?

automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.title: Automation Readiness & Operations Canvas
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.purpose: Prepare the operating model for a safely released, supported, monitored, and recoverable automation.
automationReadinessOperationsCanvas.howToUse: Use this during delivery to prepare ownership, environments, access, evidence, monitoring, support, fallback, rollback, runbooks, known risks, and the deployment decision. Use the readiness checklist later for the release gate.

businessOwner.description: Who accepts business value, process impact, residual risk, and release timing?

operationalOwner.description: Who owns runtime supervision, incidents, support, runbooks, changes, and recovery?

users.description: Which users, operators, approvers, support teams, or process participants are affected?

permissions.description: What human, service, system, data, role, and approval permissions are required and approved?

credentials.description: How are credentials, secrets, certificates, tokens, delegated access, and service identities managed?

environments.description: Which development, test, staging, production, desktop, cloud, or platform environments are used?

testEvidence.description: What proves functional correctness, rule behavior, integration behavior, agent behavior, permissions, performance, and exceptions?

exceptionHandling.description: How are errors, missing data, unsafe actions, failed runs, retries, timeouts, and handoffs handled?

monitoring.description: Which run, failure, exception, latency, cost, intervention, value, safety, and outcome signals are monitored?

support.description: Who supports users and operators, how are incidents raised, and what service expectations apply?

manualFallback.description: How can work continue manually if the automation is paused, unavailable, incorrect, or unsafe?

rollback.description: How can changes, actions, data updates, releases, or workflow versions be reversed or compensated?

documentation.description: What operating instructions, design records, architecture decisions, user guidance, and runbooks are ready?

deploymentDecision.description: What remains incomplete, conditional, or blocking before the formal readiness decision?

knownRisks.description: Which risks are accepted, mitigated, deferred, or blocking release?

improvementBacklog.description: Which improvements, unresolved assumptions, PoC findings, and future enhancements should be prioritized next?

apiBusinessModelCanvas.title: Canvas do Modelo de Negócio da API
apiBusinessModelCanvas.purpose: Qual será a viabilidade e a reutilização desta API? Temos um caso de negócio do ponto de vista de custo-benefício?
apiBusinessModelCanvas.howToUse: Resuma a proposta de valor de uma API a partir do Canvas da Proposta de Valor da API e siga a sequência numerada.

keyPartners.description: Quem são as principais partes interessadas envolvidas?

keyActivities.description: Quais são as ações mais importantes que o fornecedor da API deve realizar para operar com sucesso?

keyResources.description: Que ativos estratégicos exclusivos deve o fornecedor da API adquirir ou construir?

apiValueProposition.description: Comece com uma nota adesiva que nomeie a API ou a família de APIs e, em seguida, anote o valor que a API oferece aos seus utilizadores.

developerRelations.description: Como o fornecedor da API alcança e oferece apoio aos utilizadores da API?

channels.description: Através de quais mecanismos os utilizadores da API interagem com a API?

apiConsumerSegments.description: Quem é o público-alvo da API?

costs.description: Quais são os custos significativos envolvidos na construção, disponibilização e operação da API?

benefits.description: Quais são os benefícios significativos ou fluxos de receita gerados pela API?

apiValuePropositionCanvas.title: Canvas da Proposta de Valor da API
apiValuePropositionCanvas.purpose: Como a percurso do cliente se relaciona com as APIs? Quais dificuldades e benefícios dos utilizadores finais e utilizadores de API precisam /de ser abordados?
apiValuePropositionCanvas.howToUse: Descreva a perspetiva dos utilizadores finais, começando pelas suas tarefas, depois as suas dificuldades e benefícios e os dos utilizadores de API e, finalmente, os produtos e funcionalidades da API.

tasks.description: O que os clientes (utilizadores finais) estão a tentar alcançar?

gainEnablingFeatures.description: Que funcionalidades permitem que os utilizadores finais e utilizadores de API alcancem ganhos?

painRelievingFeatures.description: Que funcionalidades ajudam os utilizadores finais e os utilizadores da API a superar dificuldades?

apiProducts.description: Quais produtos e recursos API atendem às tarefas, dificuldades e ganhos?

businessImpactCanvas.title: Business Impact Canvas
businessImpactCanvas.purpose: What value, risk, operational, financial, customer, employee, compliance, and strategic impact is expected or at stake?
businessImpactCanvas.howToUse: Use this to connect expected benefits and consequences to architecture, prioritization, readiness, and proceed-or-stop decisions. Include the impact of not proceeding as well as critical risks and mitigations.

availabilityRisks.description: Quais são os riscos potenciais para a disponibilidade da API?

securityRisks.description: Quais são os riscos potenciais de segurança associados à API?

dataRisks.description: Quais são os riscos potenciais para a integridade ou confidencialidade dos dados?

mitigateAvailabilityRisks.description: Como o fornecedor da API pode mitigar os riscos de disponibilidade?

mitigateSecurityRisks.description: Como o fornecedor da API pode mitigar os riscos de segurança?

mitigateDataRisks.description: Como o fornecedor da API pode mitigar os riscos de dados?

expectedBenefits.description: What business, customer, employee, quality, speed, risk, compliance, or strategic benefits are expected?

operationalEfficiencyImpact.description: How could work effort, waiting time, rework, throughput, reliability, support load, or operational cost change?

customerEmployeeImpact.description: How will customers, employees, partners, operators, or support teams experience the change?

financialImpact.description: What revenue, cost, investment, savings, loss avoidance, or funding impact is expected?

complianceStrategicImpact.description: What regulatory, contractual, policy, reputation, market, ecosystem, or strategic consequences matter?

impactOfNotProceeding.description: What happens if the capability, automation, integration, or service is not improved or delivered?

risksAndCriticality.description: What availability, security, data, safety, process, adoption, or business continuity risks could affect the outcome?

mitigationsAndDecisionImpact.description: Which mitigations, constraints, trade-offs, or residual risks should influence prioritization, architecture, rollout, or readiness decisions?

capacityCanvas.title: Canvas de Capacidade
capacityCanvas.purpose: How much demand, load, timing, and scaling capacity must be understood for the capability, automation, integration, or service?
capacityCanvas.howToUse: Quantify current and expected demand, peak load, and availability needs. Record caching, rate limiting, and scaling approaches as architecture follow-up decisions rather than user requirements.

currentBusinessVolumes.description: Quais são os volumes de negócio e as taxas de transação atuais?

futureConsumptionTrends.description: Quais são as tendências de consumo futuro previstas?

peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.section: Requisitos de pico de carga e disponibilidade
peakLoadAndAvailabilityRequirements.description: Quais são os requisitos de pico de carga e disponibilidade?

cachingStrategies.description: Quais estratégias de cache podem ser usadas para otimizar o desempenho?

rateLimitingStrategies.description: Que estratégias de limitação de pedidos podem ser usadas para gerir o consumo?

scalingStrategies.description: Que estratégias de dimensionamento podem ser usadas para acomodar o crescimento?

customerJourneyCanvas.title: Canvas do Percurso do Cliente
customerJourneyCanvas.purpose: Qual é a percurso do cliente ou parceiro que a API pretende apoiar?
customerJourneyCanvas.howToUse: Descreva uma percurso real de um cliente ou utilizador — não o uso da API — para revelar pontos fracos, objetivos e contexto. Esta informação ajuda a definir que tipo de apoio de API será realmente necessário mais tarde.

customerDiscoversNeed.description: Como o cliente reconhece sua necessidade ou problema?

persona.description: Quem é o cliente típico que passa por esta percurso?

pains.description: Quais são os pontos fracos ou desafios do cliente?

journeySteps.description: Quais são as etapas que o cliente percorre em sua percurso?

customerNeedIsResolved.description: Como a necessidade do cliente é resolvida no final?

gains.description: Quais são os ganhos ou benefícios do cliente?

inputsOutputs.description: Quais são as entradas e saídas em cada etapa?

interactionProcessingRules.description: Quais são as regras de interação e processamento em cada etapa?

domainCanvas.title: Canvas de Domínio
domainCanvas.purpose: Quais são as entidades principais e as regras de negócio relacionadas com a API?
domainCanvas.howToUse: Defina o modelo de domínio para cada API, incluindo entidades, atributos e relações.

selectedCustomerJourneySteps.section: Etapas selecionadas da percurso do cliente
selectedCustomerJourneySteps.description: Quais etapas da percurso do cliente são relevantes para este domínio?

coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.section: Entidades principais e significado de negócio
coreEntitiesAndBusinessMeaning.description: Quais são as entidades principais e seu significado de negócio?

attributesAndBusinessImportance.description: Quais são os principais atributos de cada entidade e sua importância de negócio?

relationshipsBetweenEntities.description: Quais são as relações entre as entidades?

businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.section: Regras de negócio, conformidade e integridade
businessComplianceAndIntegrityRules.description: Quais são as regras de negócio, conformidade e integridade relacionadas com as entidades?

securityAndPrivacyConsiderations.description: Quais são as considerações sobre segurança e privacidade relacionadas com as entidades?

eventCanvas.title: Canvas de Eventos
eventCanvas.purpose: Quais eventos são relevantes para a API e como são processados?
eventCanvas.howToUse: Defina os eventos, os seus acionadores e a lógica de processamento para cada API.

userTaskTrigger.description: Que ação do utilizador ou evento do sistema aciona esta operação de evento?

inputEventPayload.description: Que dados estão incluídos na carga útil do evento recebido? Especifique os atributos principais.

processingLogic.description: Descreva a lógica de processamento de back-end, incluindo validações, transformações ou decisões de encaminhamento.

outputEventResult.description: Que evento ou confirmação resultante é produzido? Inclua atributos da carga útil de saída.

interactionCanvas.title: Canvas de Interação
interactionCanvas.purpose: Que tipos de interações esta API deve suportar antes de escolher uma conceção específica para o protocolo?
interactionCanvas.howToUse: Identifique que estilos de interação são realmente necessários para esta API e quais estão fora do âmbito. Utilize este canvas para esclarecer a intenção antes de mapear o resultado para REST, eventos ou GraphQL.

crudInteractions.description: As interações do tipo CRUD (Criar, Ler, Atualizar, Eliminar) são necessárias aqui?

crudInputOutputModels.section: Modelos de entrada e saída CRUD
crudInputOutputModels.description: Quais são os modelos de entrada e saída para as interações CRUD, caso esse estilo seja necessário?

crudProcessingValidation.description: Quais são as regras de processamento e validação para as interações CRUD, caso esse estilo seja necessário?

queryDrivenInteractions.description: Quais interações de leitura ou consulta são necessárias para responder às perguntas dos utilizadores?

queryDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Quais são os modelos de entrada e saída para as interações orientadas por consulta?

queryDrivenProcessingValidation.section: Processamento e validação orientados por consulta
queryDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Quais são as regras de processamento e validação para as interações orientadas por consulta?

commandDrivenInteractions.description: Quais comandos de alteração de estado são necessários, se houver?

commandDrivenInputOutputModels.section: Modelos de entrada e saída orientados por comando
commandDrivenInputOutputModels.description: Quais são os modelos de entrada e saída para as interações orientadas por comando, caso esse estilo seja necessário?

commandDrivenProcessingValidation.section: Processamento e validação orientados por comando
commandDrivenProcessingValidation.description: Quais são as regras de processamento e validação para as interações orientadas por comando, caso esse estilo seja necessário?
